notes.title: August 5, 2025 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Here is the list of changes and fixes from the August 5, 2025, maintenance. 
 
[b]Seasonal Events[/b] 
 
- Fae Yule is now scheduled with the proper dates in-game. 
The 4-hour minion missions have been enabled for the duration of Fae Yule. 
 
- Autumn Harvest is now scheduled with the proper dates in-game. 
The 4-hour minion missions have been enabled for the duration of the Autumn Harvest. 
 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
 
- Prismatic Planar Earrings and Prismatic Planar Earrings buffs for all callings now behave correctly when the character dies and respawns. 
(Previously, the buffs would disappear upon death, and the player would need to re-equip the earrings to allow the buffs to activate once more.) 
 
- The new capes from the July 22, 2025, patch are no longer dyeable. 
(When trying to dye the primary dye channel of any of the capes, the textures would disappear.) 
 
- Adjusted some images that looked distorted in the RIFT store. 
 
- Resolved an issue with the Object Distance setting not applying correctly. 
(RIFT’s object distance regulates itself with RAM usage, depending on the user’s machine capabilities – with this change, we have effectively increased the overall limit before RIFT self-regulates and reduces the object distance to favour smooth performance over pretty graphics. 
 
For low-end machines, Object Distance will continue to work as it has till now. 
Higher-end users will now see higher Object Distance more often due to the increased RAM limit usage cap – assuming the setting is set to the maximum of 180) 
 
[b]New Items[/b] 
 
Three new Ursin mounts and four new Tiger mounts have been introduced. 
These mounts will become available in RIFT in the following weeks. 
 
We thank you for your continued support! 
Your RIFT team [/p]

notes.title: RIFT EU Shard Closure Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/f9a4e1d821f9bf0a321d6ea54303a6756df578d5.jpg[/img]

Hello, dear Ascended. 
 
We have some important news to share regarding the European Shards. 
On September 30, 2024, the European shard Bloodiron will be closed as part of our efforts to consolidate shards within the EU region. 
 
[b]Why are we closing the Shard? [/b]
 
Our goal is to make it easier for players in the European region to find fellow Ascended and embark on new adventures together. 
 
[b]What steps do I have to take if I am on Bloodiron? [/b]
 
1. If you are playing on the shard Bloodiron, please consider transferring to one of the following shards: Brisesol, Brutwacht or Typhiria. 
2. Read the guide on how to transfer your character(s) to another shard [url=https://support.gamigo.com/hc/en-us/articles/203372878-RIFT-Character-Transfer-Overview][b]by clicking here[/b][/url]. 
3. Keep an eye on the official RIFT website for more details. 
 
[b]What happens if I do not transfer in time? [/b]
 
Characters that are not transferred to Brisesol, Brutwacht or Typhiria before September 30, 2024, will become unavailable, and regular play will not be possible. We advise you to transfer to your preferred shard as soon as possible. 
 
[i]Please note that during this period, the character limit on the EU region will be lifted to facilitate transfers. [b]We recommend having no more than 14 characters on a single shard[/b]. If you exceed this limit, characters beyond the 14th will become inaccessible, and the only way to recover them is to delete some of your accessible characters. [/i]
 
We appreciate your continued support as we strive to ensure you can continue playing with other Ascended. 
 
Your RIFT team

tags.feature: Please note that during this period, the character limit on the EU region will be lifted to facilitate transfers.

notes.title: Important notice in regard to NA shards
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/7e4a5bde96f771c82ed7faeabdfacc719210019d.jpg[/img]

Hello, Ascended, 
we would like to share some important news regarding the shards Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol following our initial shard closure announcement. 
 
Starting today, the shards previously closed will become available to transfer characters to active shards until December 10, 2024. 
 
[b]Which shards are becoming available, and can I play on them?[/b] 
 
The NA Shards Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol are becoming available, but you will not be able to play on them, only transferring will be available during this transfer period. 
 
[b]Which shards can I transfer to?[/b] 
 
The available destination shards are Deepwood, Wolfsbane, Greybriar and Laethys. 
 
[b]How do I transfer? [/b]
 
Transferring is simple:  
 
1. Log in with the Glyph account, where your characters are located. 
2. Select and open the shard where your characters are found. 
3. Select the character you wish to Transfer. 
4. Click on “Transfer”. 
5. Select any of the 4 available shards and confirm. 
6. Your character will now be on an active shard and will be playable again. 

[i]We are aware that characters that have mails on their character cannot transfer. Therefore, please reach out per ticket.[/i]
 
How long do I have to transfer? 
 
The period to transfer from Seastone, Faeblight and Hailol is six months (until December 10, 2024). 
 
[b]We advise all players to move as soon as possible before the transfer period concludes. [/b]
 
Your RIFT team.

Pick up four daily quests in the main cities [b]Sanctum[/b], [b]Meridian[/b], or [b]Tempest Bay.[/b] 
 
[b]1. Minions of Migration [/b]
[i]Complete an expert dungeon through Groupfinder (LFG) and get rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes! [/i]

[b]2. Birds of a Feather Train Together [/b]
[i]Press K to open the PvP window and queue up for a Warfront, win it and get rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes! [/i]

[b]3. Off to the Races[/b]
[i]Pick up the quest for the Budgie race and complete it to be rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes![/i]

[b]4. For the Birds [/b]
[i]In Silverwood, Freemarch, Shimmersand, Stillmoor, and Vostigar Peaks will be a Special Budgie Zone Event called ‘The Birds’. Complete the Event and get rewarded with 15 Chaos Motes. [/i]

Discover new daily quests on NPC ‘[b]Frank Stroher[/b]’. 

Each quest gives [b]15 Chaos Motes[/b]. One available per day. 
 
Budgie Wisp 
Budgie Spirit 
Lost Hatchling 
Budgie Mare 
Mystical Hatchling 
Test Budgie 
Test Crow 
Energy Stone 
Lost Medallio 
Void Conductor 
Tawern's Cup 
Librarian's Lost Book

[url=https://www.cadrift.net/events/call-to-action/budgies/]CADRIFT – Budgies[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/5c2d1b6592232d90391c1d0383572dda3d19f7b3.png[/img]

[h3=carnivalevent]Carnival Event[/h3]

Grab your [b]Carnival Mask[/b] and get ready to celebrate [b]11 years with us on RIFT[/b].  
Beautiful decorations await you in all major [b]cities[/b]! Go on weekly or daily quests within the next [b]four weeks[/b] and get rewarded with Loot Bags, Mounts, and more! You can also collect [b]Carnival Prize Tickets[/b]. These tickets are awarded for completing a [b]Carnival Game[/b]. They can be redeemed in the World Event section of the[b] RIFT Store[/b] for special prizes. 
 
[b]Weekly Quest[/b]

Talk to Dantwor Honey-Tongue at the docks in Tempest Bay to accept the weekly quest called “Clean House at the Carnival”. You need to complete 50 Carnival mini-games and will be rewarded with 2 Auroral Doubloons that can be exchanged in the Carnival shop for other rewards and one Carnival Celebration Crate. 

  
[b]Mini Games[/b]

There are various repeatable mini-games such as the very popular Balloon Stomp. If you want to play it please refer to the [url=https://www.cadrift.net/events/carnival/quests/]Balloon Jumping Etiquette[/url]. 

  
[b]Daily Quests[/b]

Among other activities, you can take part in daily quests like Frog Wrangling or visit Sijay Creg in your home city for additional quests to complete 5 Carnival Instant Adventures. 
 
You can also find more details on the following community page: 

[url=https://www.cadrift.net/events/carnival/quests/]CADRIFT – Carnival[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/8964ba9b4529bc0759d3d76358887be6ba9afd27.png[/img]

[h3=springitems]Spring Items[/h3]

Spring is also joining the party, and you will be able to celebrate the spring festival with numerous themed items such as various bunny ears or special clothing.  
 
[b]Bunny Ears[/b]
Get the costume pieces for your character and celebrate spring with us. 
But watch out! Even the Bunnies will be jealous.  
 
[b]Transformation Potion[/b]
You can never get enough of the cute bunnies?  
Take one of the potions and transform yourself into the cutest thing you’ve ever seen: 
 
Alo's Amazing Marshmellow Fluff 
Alo's Amazing Daisy Dough 
[i]The version only last 5 minutes and cannot be reused.[/i]

Alo's Infinity Marshmellow Fluff 
Alo's Infinity Daisy Dough 
[i]The infinite version can be reused as often as you like.[/i]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/2480908/c8b609cfc131417abbe79b5998076829d446c7eb.gif[/img] 

We wish you a lot of fun with the [b]‘Budgie Carnival Celebration[/b]’ Patch. 
 
See you in the game, 
Your RIFT Team

notes.title: Carnival of the Ascended 2021!
notes.content:
Greetings, Ascended!

Celebrate with us the Carnival of the Ascended 2021, marking the 10th anniversary of the release of Rift. The World Event will start on March 25th and will last 4 weeks, until April 22nd, 2021 at 15.30.00 local server time.

The event will have three distinct phases that start on the following dates:
- [b]Phase 1[/b]: Thursday 25th of March
- [b]Phase 2[/b]: Thursday 15th of April at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 3[/b]: Thursday 22nd of April at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]End of the event[/b]: Thursday 29th of April at 15.30.00 local server time


What can you look forward to?


[b]New Artifact Sets[/b]

• Added three new Artifact sets. Collecting each one will be rewarded a Celebration Chest containing, among other items, 4 Auroral Doubloons!

Our Overlord
- Completing a 4-hour Carnival Minion Mission has a 50% chance to drop a Celebration Bag for Overlords that will grant a random artifact of this set.

Hero Generation
- Among the rewards for killing one of the Carnival IA bosses, players will receive a Celebration Bag for Adventurers that will grant a random artifact of this set.

Pinata Candy
- Hunt Pinatas across Telara for a 50% chance to drop a Celebration Bag for Pinata Hunters that will grant a random artifact of this set.

• Collect and complete all the three new artifact sets to earn the True Veteran achievement, which will give the "Elder" prefix title and 100 platinum.


[b]New Minion[/b]

• Uncover the story of the old Ascended Trillian Lockwert by acquiring its Minion Card
- Upon collecting it, a chain of 11 Minion Missions will be unlocked. Complete them all to acquire 5 new Minions, 4 collectible journal entries with Trillians story, and some additional Carnival of the Ascended currency!
- Get the full group to level 25 to unlock the "Long-lived" suffix Title through an achievement.


[b]Updated LootTables[/b]

• The Pinata Prize Bags obtained in Carnival IAs can now drop some of the pets added during the Carnival of the Ascended in 2020!


[b]New Items[/b]

• Support your faction! Obtain one of the Guardian Valmeras or the Defiant Warhorses with Auroral Doubloons or Credits to show your support and unlock an exclusive title through an achievement.

• Complement your faction looks with the Ascended Guardian or Defiant Wings. Or be a proud Telaran with the Tenth Anniversary Cape.

• The new Tenth Anniversary Cake will grant you a raid consumable granting 100 Endurance and it was modeled after the real Rift Release Cake that the studio made 10 years ago for the launch! Also available as a Dimensional item to sweeten your home.

• Ever wanted to trick others to be Unicorns and join your cavalry? The Fancy Celebration Cake can be placed for everyone to turn into Carnival Unicorns and ride along with you and will grant a special achievement with a vanity unlock: the Celebration Ruff!


[b]Fixes[/b]

• Store - Fixed an issue with older Carnival Dimensional items not appearing unless all class types were selected.

• Dimension - Floating Platform Device no longer duplicates itself visually when rotating the item in a dimension.

• Mystic Archer - Legendary Ride the Wind now reduces the cast time of Summoning Quiver as expected.

• Oracle - Prevented an exploit where Legendary Insignia of Blood could be triggered with non-damaging abilities.


What are you waiting for? Come and celebrate with us! Happy birthday, Rift!

notes.title: Fae Yule 2020 has arrived!
notes.content:
Get ready for the most festive time of the year in Telara! Greatfather Frost has arrived and brings back Fae Yule for 2020!

The World Event begins today, [b]December 10, 2020 at 3.30 PM local server time[/b] and will conclude on [b]Thursday, January 7, 2021 at 3.30 PM local server time[/b].

Participate in the Fae Yule festivities to earn [b]Unique Snowflakes[/b] and [b]Dark Icicles[/b] to obtain all the new items!


[b]Fae Yule 2020[/b]
What awaits you in this year's Fae Yule event? See below!


The event will have three distinct phases that start on the following dates:
- [b]Phase 1[/b]: Thursday 10th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 2[/b]: Thursday 17th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]Phase 3[/b]: Thursday 24th of December at 15.30.00 local server time
- [b]End of the event[/b]: Thursday 7th of January at 15.30.00 local server time


The Fae Yule Store will be active from:
- [b]Start[/b]: Thursday 10th of December at 08.05.00 local server time
- [b]End[/b]: Thursday 14th of January at 08.00.00 local server time


[b]Adjustments[/b]
The price of previous year's pets and minions has been lowered permanently.


[b]New Essences[/b]
Push the limits of your essences with the new Seraphic Zephyr and Seraphic Torrent Unique essences, with a focus on each of the main stats.
Shadowpriest (WIS), Shadowcaller (INT), Shade Stalker (DEX), and Death Knight (STR) versions are available.


[b]New Vanity and Mounts[/b]
The Fae whisper about the evil alchemist that lurks in the dark hunting those boglings that have misbehaved this year. Remind them about their folk tales with the Nebulous Omen Cape or the Infinity Flask vanity items.

Always loved the starry nights in Telara? The new Astral Wings and the Astral Voyager levitation mount are here to immortalize its beauty! But if you prefer to see the stars by yourself, get on top of the Mighty Woolly Explorer, our new mount, and travel to the highest mountains to enjoy the view. Remember to stay warm though, or you will end up looking like our new Icy Levitation, a special levitation that makes you frosty!


[b]New Minions[/b]
Welcome Mr.Quackers and Leah the Cool to the roster of minions! These two old pals are still looking for their long lost friend Frosty Paws.
Collect both minions to unlock the exclusive title "Winter Spirit" and level them both to level 15 to unlock the minion "Frosty Paws"!


[b]New Pets[/b]
The forecast from the Icewatch was correct. This winter is going to be one of the coldest in Telara, and the patrols are starting to find out all kinds of frozen creatures.
Consider adopting one to warm it up? The new frozen pet set is available! Collect Flurry, Snowfall, Drift, Avalanche, Slush, Tundra, Powder, Glacier, Sleet or Rime!


Happy holidays, Ascended!

notes.title: Glyph Update Issue Fix
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/03ddeef328a749af9ec83c34b26325acdc07fd7d.jpg[/img]

Greetings folks, 

As you may have noticed, recently we’ve been experiencing some certificate issues with our websites. These same issues also caused some players to have trouble accessing games. 

We’ve released fixes for the majority of these issues, but we have an update coming for Glyph that should be the final step to resolving this completely. Unfortunately, players using older versions of Glyph won’t be able to update to this newest version. 

If you have trouble updating Glyph you’ll want to delete it from your computer and download the latest version. [url=https://www.trionworlds.com/glyph/download/en/]Find the latest version here[/url]. 

We’re very sorry for any inconvenience this causes. 

Thanks very much.

notes.title: Autumn Harvest: Extended
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/d7ab9e0ad49de66179f4920d9b3e7ab27c2c5385.jpg[/img]

Update - Autumn Harvest is being extended an extra week and will now run through November 14, 2018!

Cool breezes and brightly colored leaves usher in Autumn Harvest starting today, October 18th! Wings, heads and tails. [b]Tails?[/b] YES, we've introduced our very first tail item in RIFT!

Take a half dozen toxic spores from the Xarth Mire, mix in some devious beasties, swirl them together with toxic miasma and just like that, we're ready for the season of spirits!

Claim Lady Glasya's wings in the RIFT Store on Live or Prime! These pinions are loaded with dark power, and are served up in both cosmetic and mount versions in the pack, offering you flexibility in your pairings! [b]This just in: you may also choose Lady Glasya's TAIL from the pack, the very first tail item ever offered in RIFT![/b]

Noxious Levitation will leave a cloud of poisonous ruin in your wake as you travel across Telara. They will be offered for Credits on Live and a consumable version for event currency on Prime.

We'll have more images of the terrific new items next week and will feature them on the October 19th Livestream, where Autumn Harvest and Extra-Life share the stage! Please join [url=https://www.extra-life.org/index.cfm?fuseaction=donorDrive.team&teamID=39909][b]Team Trion[/b][/url] in supporting the Children's Miracle Network Hospitals to help the wee ones who cannot help themselves! Even $5 helps more than you could imagine. Together with our Trion creators, we've raised almost $400,000 for Extra-Life over the past eight years... help us take it even further.

 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/9608a433affcd57838a44b1f7c850e6522dd767c.jpg[/img]

[h1][u]Lady Glasya is only too happy to share her wings with you this year! (Concept art)[/u][/h1]
 

[b]AUTUMN HARVEST RUNS OCTOBER 18th through November 8th, 2018[/b]

We have some amazing new items for you to chase this year in our traditional Autumn Harvest festivities! This event is presented on both Live and Prime servers, and you begin your adventures in Meridian or Sanctum, as ever.

 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/912c052a5e384b5edb4538c842bf8b26ddb63d2f.jpg[/img]


 

All of the below may be earned in game by the most dedicated of Autumnal celebrants:

 

[b]Gruesome weapon skins:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Bulwark[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Broadsword[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Corseque[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Stormcaller[/*]
 	[*]Deathwalker's Rimed Warbow[/*]
 	[*]Top them off with the Noxious Rune for the complete effect![/*]
[/list]
 

[b]Adorable, creepy companion pets:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Addy, a teensy mummified Aedraxulos[/*]
 	[*]Tut-tut, a teeny mummy[/*]
 	[*]Glinda, the Corgi Witch[/*]
[/list]
 

[b]The ghastliest backpack looks for the season:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Infernalist's Vade Mecum[/*]
 	[*]Lexicon of Bone[/*]
[/list]
 

[b]Wardrobe additions to haunt you:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Deathly Witch's Hat[/*]
 	[*]Frightening Jack-O-Lantern Mask[/*]
 	[*]Orphiel Mask[/*]
 	[*]Soul Reaper's Cowl[/*]
 	[*]Demonic Clown Mask[/*]
 	[*]Demonic Nightmare Helm[/*]
 	[*]Cyclopean Nightmare Helm[/*]
 	[*]Primal Visage of Courage (Glowing Corgi Mask)[/*]
[/list]
 

[b]Dimension goods to suit the season![/b]
[list]
 	[*]Xarth Mire Dimension Key - what could be more in keeping with our soulful theme than a pestilence-ridden swamp?[/*]
 	[*]Autumn Festival Dimension Items. A variety of unusual items hand-selected by Salvatrix from the darkest corners of the Comet to suit our theme! Do NOT attempt to eat the mushrooms... and watch out for the rat, bat and spiderling swarms![/*]
[/list]
Join us in the festivities on Live and Prime servers!

Remember, we're keeping an EYE out for you!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/b922c94a4fac2c41b8cf1f018f27db642f2960b3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: EVENT: Mechs on Parade!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/77c5adc70245f0092a4ea79171a70e49b9942d5a.jpg[/img]

Mechanical Walkers are suddenly growing in number across Telara - could it be the influence of Crucia?

There is something immensely satisfying in tromping around with your own personal mech-style mount, and we've got a whole parade for you this week! Rumble through the lands in your clanking metal machine... why not start a parade? Send us your screenshots @RIFTgame - how many can you get to join you?
[b]PRIME Store:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The Red & Iron Empyreal Walker has blasted its way through to the Vigil server at last! First of its kind, ready for you![/*]

[b]LIVE Store:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]NEW Faewood Infinity Walker[/*]
 	[*]NEW Red & Silver Empyreal Walker[/*]
[/list]
 

[b]WORLD EVENT: Available on Live and Prime for Chaos Motes![/b]

Collect enough for special Walkers - this event runs from[b] September 28 to October 1st, 2018[/b]. As with other World Events, there will be a quest starter in each home city. You'll be asked to run an Expert Dungeon with LFG, participate in Warfronts, complete the Mech Zone Event, and collect drops from special Mech Invasions and Footholds!
[list]

 	[*]Black Empyreal Walker[/*]

In addition to the clanking wonders, you can earn:
[list]
 	[*]Mech Companion Pets[/*]

 	[*]New Dimension items![/*]
[/list]
 

What are you waiting for?
Bolt yourself in and join the Mech Parade!

[/LIST]

[LIST]

[LIST]

[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] The merchants from Grim Remembrance will hang around for an extra week to give Ascended the chance to spend their currencies.

[/LIST]
[*] Summerfest
[LIST]
[*] Summerfest has been extended by one week! It will now end on Wednesday, August 8, 2018 instead of August 2, 2018.
[*] The plat cost of the dimension items added to the store last week have been reduced by 75%.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]

ITEMS
[LIST]
[*] •	Corrected the Spectral Carriage mount’s description to no longer mistakenly list itself as a 160% speed mount. This only applies to the direct purchased version in the Summerfest section of the RIFT store. Older Spectral Carriages from lockboxes are not affected.
[/LIST]
QUESTS
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with the “In the Image of my Enemy” quest in Droughtlands where the Saboteur Time Bomb Catalyst buff could remove the disguise needed for the quest.
[/LIST]

[b]== PRIME: VIGIL PATCH NOTES ==[/b]

ACHIEVEMENTS
[LIST]
[*] The Fall of Lantern Hook (Expert) achievement “Right Meow” now updates correctly.
[/LIST]

[LIST]

[LIST]
[*] A Call to Action has been issued to the Ascended to deal with the sudden appearance of Hellbugs throughout Telara.
[/LIST]

[LIST]

[LIST]

[/LIST]

[LIST]

[/LIST]
RAIDS
[LIST]
[*] River of Souls
[LIST]
[*] Albeth’s Grave Bolt has had its damage increased.
[*] Alsbeth has displeased Regulos. As punishment he has taken a portion of vitality away from her and the servants who directly protect her.
[*] Alsbeth has granted Putonus the liberty to make some adjustments to the area outside his arena. Spectators may have a less than ideal time watching the encounter.
[*] Alsbeth the Discordant has grown tired of Ascended who have fallen in battle re-entering the battle with her minions. Ascended who choose to respawn while their raid is engaged with a boss will need to wait until the boss dies or resets before rejoining their allies.
[*] Alsbeth was not pleased that several of her minions could not go after Ascended hiding behind rocks. These minions have been replaced by new minions who do not take pity on ascended who hide behind rocks.
[*] Altered some damage values in Herald Gaurath encounter based on player feedback.
[*] BoE random drops have had their drop rates fixed.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Alsbeth and her minions from doing the proper damage when enraged.

[LIST]
[*] Cleric
[LIST]
[*] Purifier

[LIST]
[*] Grim Remembrance
[LIST]
[*] Alsbeth the Discordant sneers at the Ascended, “Fools! You are so pathetic in your attempts to stop me. I’ve told my commanders to kill you all slower, to let you linger longer.”

[LIST]
[*] The Ravesong mount is once again available in the Rift Store for players that completed the appropriate achievement.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] The Planarite Cost for Tenebrean Planar Attuners has been greatly reduced.
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Defiant and Guardian guilds now have to close the same number of Rifts in the quest “Upping the Ante”.
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Ashenfell
[LIST]
[*] Rift mobs in Ashenfell no longer clip through rocks and get stuck.
[/LIST]
[*] Iron Pike Peak
[LIST]
[*] Che’om’eiss is grounded and no longer allowed in the ceiling of Icewatch Ridge. Bad Abyssal Dream Delver - No biscuit!
[/LIST]
[*] Mathosian Mill
[LIST]
[*] The Mathosian Mill interior no longer erroneously says “Deepwood Cottage”.
[/LIST] 
[*] Vostigar Peaks
[LIST]

[/LIST]
[/LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Cleric
[LIST]
[*] Purifier
[LIST]

CHRONICLES
[LIST]
[*] You can now join chronicles while mentored.
[/LIST]
EMBER ISLE
[LIST]

[LIST]
[*] Grim Remembrance
[LIST]
[*] Alsbeth the Discordant sneers at the Ascended, “Fools! You are so pathetic in your attempts to stop me. I’ve told my commanders to kill you all slower, to let you linger longer.”

notes.content:

[B]== LIVE SERVER NOTES ==[/B]
Due to the extended downtimes that occurred yesterday and today, we are extending bonus XP through the end of Sunday, July 15, 2018. Thanks for your patience, Ascended! 

CHRONICLES
[LIST]
[*] The Ceremony of Attunement, which was previously postponed due to Yrlwalach induced rain, has been rescheduled. Come and join the celebration where absolutely, positively nothing will go awry.
[/LIST]
[B]Events[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Grim Remembrance
[LIST]
[*] The quest “Tools of Destruction” has been removed from the achievement requirements for “Grim Tasks”.
[*] The event merchant has improved their organization of wares.
[*] Clicking on the Achievements button in the World Event UI now takes you directly to the Grim Remembrance achievement section.
[*] The iLvl of level 70 gear has been increased (vastly in some cases).
[/LIST]
[*] Summerfest
[LIST]
[*] The new Island Cove dimension is now properly flagged as a rest area.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]ITEMS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] For level 70 raid gear with randomized suffixes (concats), the odds of any particular concat have been evened out.
[*] The cosmetic unlock of the Estrodian Wings should now function properly. For players that have already purchased the Estrodian Wings, you can get the wardrobe unlock by logging in any character that has not yet claimed the mount and wardrobe item from the mail (or create a new character to do so) and go claim the wings from the mail.
[/LIST]
[B]NPCs[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Xarth Mire
[LIST]
[*] Jubjub and a few other boglings in Bailghol have returned to their intended spots on top of the docks rather than hanging out under them all shady-like.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]

[B]== PRIME: VIGIL PATCH NOTES ==[/B]
Due to the extended downtimes that occurred yesterday and today, we are extending bonus XP through the end of Sunday, July 15, 2018. Thanks for your patience, Ascended! 

ACHIEVEMENTS
[LIST]
[*] The following achievement categories have been unhidden on Prime: Ember Isle, Grim remembrance, Chronicles, and Ceremony of Attunement.
[/LIST]
[B]Chronicles[/B]
[LIST]
[*] The Ceremony of Attunement, which was previously postponed due to Yrlwalach induced rain, has been rescheduled. Come and join the celebration where absolutely, positively nothing will go awry.
[/LIST]
EVENTS
[LIST]
[*] Grim Remembrance
[LIST]
[*] The quest “Tools of Destruction” has been removed from the achievement requirements for “Grim Tasks”.
[*] The event merchant has improved their organization of wares.
[*] Clicking on the Achievements button in the World Event UI now takes you directly to the Grim Remembrance achievement section.
[/LIST]
[*] Summerfest
[LIST]
[*] The new Island Cove dimension is now properly flagged as a rest area.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
KNOWN ISSUES
[LIST]
[*] The Achievement for Cadeceus Rise is still hidden on Prime. We will fix this in an upcoming hotfix.
[*] The chronicle UI shows you’re not eligible to enter if you’re level 50 and mentored down. We will fix this in an upcoming hotfix as well.
[/LIST]

notes.title: The Next Big Prime Update is Here! Introducing 4.5!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/48a87a5388780be03d1dfc4df50a945cef9066e3.jpg[/img]

It’s Prime time to play RIFT Prime, now that our next big update, 4.5 is here!

Beginning July 11, 2018, RIFT Prime is updated to 4.5, which includes tons of new content like quests, onslaughts, new gear, planar attunement, class balance updates, and much, much more!

[h1]Ember Isle[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/539b8590eb38e4f74fb912436fb279f8125cc154.jpg[/img]

The long awaited Ember Isle is ready to explore on Prime. Considered by many to be one of RIFT’s most beautiful zones, this lush tropical paradise is home to the Farclan Dwarves and the Kelari who battle for the resources of the island. And in the center the menacing presence to Mount Cacera an active volcano, what secrets lie in its heart.
[list]
 	[*]Over 30 new quests[/*]
 	[*]More than a dozen new Rifts[/*]
 	[*]Over 20 more achievements[/*]
 	[*]More than 15 new rare creatures to track down[/*]
 	[*]More zone events[/*]
 	[*]Even a new zone puzzle - all the things you expect from a full-featured RIFT zone[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Introducing Onslaughts for Prime[/h1]

When the fissures known as the Sourcewells first appeared, it was quickly realized that these founts of energy were like a bountiful feed trough for the planar invaders on the island. Many Kelari found themselves called to take up the mantle of the five heroes and guard the Sourcewells. They built the defenses and, to this day, remain at their posts, giving their very lives to deny this food to the enemy.
[list]
 	[*]Take a defensive position and get ready for battle[/*]
 	[*]Upgrade the Lifesprings and Turrets to give yourself the best chance of survival[/*]
 	[*]Improve your power against the plains by upgrading the Dense Arch at the center of each Sourcewell[/*]
 	[*]Earn the respect of the Keepers and gain access to their merchants[/*]
[/list]
[h1]New Treasures in Caduceus Rise[/h1]

Caduceus, a powerful Telaran Sprit, has been corrupted by energy from the Plane of Earth. The Kelari built a temple at Caduceus Rise to honor this sprit where they would offer him gifts in exchange for boons. This was long ago in the past. Today, the Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple. They have been haggling with Caduceus.

Meanwhile Laethys has been transported through The Plan of Fire to Ember Isle in the form of golden treasure from the hardened liquid gold in Chalmers Caldera. Her spirit was torn in the journey, and fragments of her soul became bound to objects of wealth scattered about Ember Isle.

The Golden Maw formed an agreement with Caduceus for the spirit to use its powerful Earth magic to help reform Laethys a corporal dragon. Will the Ascended be able to stop this diabolical plan before it’s too late?
[list]
 	[*]The Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple at Caduceus Rise, built by the Kelari to honor the powerful Telaran spirit, Caduceus.[/*]
 	[*]In their ongoing efforts to give Laethys a corporeal form, her cult followers have made an agreement with Caduceus to lend his powerful Earth magic to their cause.[/*]
 	[*]By negating Caduceus' assistance, the Ascended buy more time against Laethys' attempts to return to full strength on Telara.[/*]
 	[*]Both Expert Caduceus Rise and Expert Upper Caduceus Rise will be available.[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Planar Attunement Now on Prime[/h1]

Worthy Guardians are granted these powers through a ritual with the Messenger of the Vigil and the great piece of sourcestone in the heart of Sanctum. The Ascended is said to have been brought closer to The Vigil and thus able to interact with planar energies in a manner more akin to that of the Vigil.

For the Defiants, a new machine was constructed by Sylver Valis that would attune them to The Planes more closely. Defiant Ascended were returned in bodies made of sourcestone. Sylver's machine attunes this sourcestone to the planes from which it was created.
[list]
 	[*]Planar Attunements provide base enhancements to your character's Calling from each Plane, and is not Soul-specific.[/*]
 	[*]Your experience bar will turn into a Planar Attunement meter when you reach level 50. The mouseover tooltip will indicate that you are earning experience toward Planar Attunement.[/*]
 	[*]You must purchase all Planar Attunement abilities of a given tier before you can begin spending points in the next tier up. More tiers will be unlocked in future updates.[/*]
 	[*]Rested experience does not apply to post-level-50 Planar Attunement experience.[/*]
[/list]

To learn more about all the changes in the 4.5 update, check out the [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-prime-vigil-discussion-reading-anyone-posting-patron-only/prime-vigil-patch-notes/505587-rift-4-5-update-7-11-2018-a.html]patch notes for Prime here[/url]. Then, don’t forget to give us feedback on this update in ththis thread. If you’ve left Prime, now is the perfect time to return and enjoy all this new content.

notes.title: RIFT 4.5 Update 7/11/2018 (Prime)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/f1a970bf9bbcc6f2be6e0cc8ac735ce36df7ae9c.jpg[/img]
[b]RIFT 4.5: 7/11/2018[/b]

[COLOR="mediumturquoise"][SIZE="4"][B]== PRIME: VIGIL PATCH NOTES ==[/B][/SIZE][/COLOR]
The long awaited Ember Isle is ready to explore on PRIME.

Considered by many to be one of RIFT’s most beautiful zones, this lush tropical paradise is home to the Farclan Dwarves and the Kelari who battle for the resources of the island. And in the center the menacing presence to Mount Cacera an active volcano, what secrets lie in its heart.
[LIST]
[*] Over 30 new quests
[*] More than dozen new RIFTS
[*] Over 20 more achievements
[*] More than 15 new rare creatures to track down
[*] More zone events
[*] Even a new zone puzzle. All the things you expect from a full featured RIFT zone
[/LIST]

[B]Ember Isle introduces Onslaughts for the first time on PRIME.[/B]
When the fissures known as the Sourcewells first appeared it was quickly realized that these founts of energy were like a bountiful feed trough for the planar invaders on the island. Many Kelari found themselves called to volunteer to take up the mantle of the five heroes and guard the Sourcewells. They built the defenses and, to this day, remain at their posts, giving their very lives (and sometimes beyond) to deny this food to the enemy.
[LIST]
[*] Take a defensive position and get ready for battle
[*] Upgrade the Lifesprings and Turrets to give yourself the best chance of survival
[*] Improve your power against the plains by upgrading the Dense Arch at the center of each Sourcewell
[*] Earn the respect of the Keepers and gain access to their stores
[/LIST]
[B]What treasures are waiting to be claimed in Caduceus Rise?[/B]
Caduceus, a powerful Telaran Sprit has been corrupted by energy from the Plane of Earth. The Kelari built a temple at Caduceus Rise to honor this sprit where they would offer him gifts in exchange for boons. This was long ago in the past. Today the Golden Maw as well as some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple. They have been haggling with Caduceus.

Meanwhile Laethys has been transported through The Plan of Fire to Ember Isle in the form of golden treasure from the hardened liquid gold in Chalmers Caldera. Her spirit was torn in the journey, and fragments of her soul became bound to objects of wealth scattered about Ember Isle. 

The Golden Maw formed an agreement with Caduceus for the spirit to use its powerful Earth magic to help reform Laethys a corporal dragon. Will the Ascended be able to stop this diabolical plan before it’s too late?
[LIST]
[*] The Golden Maw and some of their Wanton allies occupy the temple at Caduceus Rise, built by the Kelari to honor the powerful Telaran spirit, Caduceus.
[*] In their ongoing efforts to give Laethys a corporeal form, her cult followers have made an agreement with Caduceus to lend his powerful Earth magic to their cause.
[*] By negating Caduceus' assistance, the Ascended buy more time against Laethys' attempts to return to full strength on Telara.
[*] Both Expert Caduceus Rise and Expert Upper Caduceus Rise will be available.
[/LIST]
[B]Planar Attunement will make more power and abilities available to players.[/B]
Worthy Guardians are granted these powers through a ritual with the Messenger of the Vigil and the great piece of sourcestone in the heart of Sanctum. The Ascended is said to have been brought closer to The Vigil and thus able to interact with planar energies in a manner more akin to that of the Vigil.

For the Defiants, a new machine was constructed by Sylver Valis that would attune them to The Planes more closely. Defiant Ascended were returned in bodies made of sourcestone. Sylver's machine attunes this sourcestone to the planes from which it was created.
[LIST]
[*] Planar Attunements provide base enhancements to your character's Calling from each Plane, and is not Soul-specific.
[*] Your experience bar will turn into a Planar Attunement meter when you reach level 50. The mouseover tooltip will indicate that you are earning experience toward Planar Attunement.
[*] You must purchase all Planar Attunement abilities of a given tier before you can begin spending points in the next tier up.
[*] Rested experience does not apply to post-level-50 Planar Attunement experience.
[/LIST]
[B]BANK[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow you to move items directly from your shard vault to your bank.
[/LIST]
[B]CALLINGS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue causing many procs to incorrectly proc other procs. This has been a long-standing issue and may result in some abilities or procs no longer interacting with other buffs and effects as they have previously. We’ll continue to monitor abilities for any unintended side effects. If you believe you’ve found one, please let us know on the forums!
[*] Cleric
[LIST]
[*] Purifier
[LIST]
[*] Flame of Life – Adjusted stacking priority for Flame of Life and Legendary Flame of Life to correctly reflect the damage reduction provided by the ability.
[*] Legendary Flash of the Phoenix now has its cooldown reduced to 30s, and no longer triggers the shared combat rez cooldown, if cast on a living ally.
[/LIST]
[*] Runeshaper
[LIST]
[*] Bonus Rune of Smiting damage from Legendary Seal of Vulnerability can now only be triggered by the Seal’s original caster. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, could occasionally refresh a normal Seal of Vulnerability with the legendary version. 
[*] Fixed another issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, would refresh Seal of Pain with Seal of Vulnerability instead. 
[*] Fixed a minor issue where an extra debuff effect would appear on the target momentarily when Seal of Enhancement was cast.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Mage
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with Eldritch Armor where Bloom would consume the reactive buff.
[*] Chloromancer
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the cast time reduction from Harbinger’s Eldritch Armor proc from affecting Bloom or Flourish if less than 2 points have been spent in Healing Slipstream.
[/LIST]
[*] Harbinger
[LIST]
[*] Tempest Winds no longer requires a Blade buff.
[*] Updated Lightning Charge to provide the same damage proc from Slashing attacks as Lightning Blade.
[*] New Ability: Luminous Blessing – This is a copy of the Luminous Weapon ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained at the same time you gain Luminous Weapon.
[*] New Ability: Reaper’s Essence – This is a copy of the Reaper’s Blade ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained when you gain Reaper’s Blade. There is also a Legendary version of this ability that is gained whenever Legendary Reaper’s Blade is selected.
[*] Legendary Reaper’s Blade and Legendary Reaper’s Essence now grant their damage bonus for the full duration of the buff instead of as a proc when an enemy dies.
[/LIST]
[*] Mystic Archer
[LIST]
[*] The wardrobe appearance “Crumbling Ivory Magus Bow” is now unlocked for any account that has purchased the Mystic Archer class.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Arcane Summoning from working correctly when multiple Mages with the talent are attacking the same target. This talent should now work independently for each Mage.
[/LIST]
[*] Necromancer
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Reaper’s Touch – This now causes the Mage’s pet’s damaging abilities to apply 2 additional stacks of Deathly Calling while Reaper’s Touch is active.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the enemy had more than 5 stacks of Deathly Calling, Desecrate would only deal damage as though there were 5 stacks and then remove all Deathly Calling stacks. Desecrate will now deal damage correctly based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy.
[*] Removed Legendary Grave Rot.
[*] Added Legendary Desecrate – Deals Death damage based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy. Curses the enemy for 20s, increasing damage taken from the Mage’s pet by 5% per stack of Deathly Calling on the enemy when Desecrate is cast.
[*] Due to the removal of Legendary Grave Rot, all builds using the Necromancer soul have had their talent points refunded.
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent Lich Form from being cast.
[*] Fixed an issue when a Mage has both Legendary Condemn and Legendary Reaper’s Touch, Deathly Calling would not stack higher than 5 while Legendary Reaper’s Touch was active.
[*] Increased the duration of Legendary Reaper’s Touch to 16s. Increased damage of both the damage over time portion and the damage burst at the end.
[*] Putrify now causes the Necromancer pet to apply the maximum number of stacks of Deathly Calling to the enemy. (i.e. It will now apply 10 stacks if you have Legendary Condemn).
[*] Legendary Condemn now also increases the Mage’s damage to the enemy by 1% per stack.
[/LIST]
[*] Pyromancer
[LIST]
[*] Updated the talent description for Pyromancer’s Vengeance to accurately reflect how the talent functions. It now indicates it increases the proc chance of Pyromancer’s Blessing by 2/4% per stack instead of 1 / 2% per stack. This is only a change to the tooltip and does not affect talent or ability functionality.
[/LIST]
[*] Stormcaller
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Wind Chill would consume a stack from Pyromancer’s Internalize Charge.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlock
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing multiple Mages from having Lingering Torment, from Legendary Neddra’s Grasp, active on an enemy at the same time.
[*] Legendary Life Leech – Updated the ability description to indicate the percent chance for non-warlock abilities to refresh Life Leech.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Rogue
[LIST]
[*] Bard
[LIST]
[*] The Oracle buff Inspiration of Survival is no longer able to overwrite Motif of Regeneration.
[/LIST]
[*] Marksman
[LIST]
[*] Fixed several issues with Legendary Rapid Fire Shot. Fixed an issue allowing each use of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot on the same target to provide a multiplicative bonus to all subsequent casts of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot from other Rogues for the duration of the attack. Fixed an issue with damage interval timing.
[*] Updated Legendary Rapid Fire Shot to deal damage more closely matching numbers in the ability description.
[/LIST]
[*] Saboteur
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Detonate would cause Scatter Sticky Bomb to deal damage twice as many times as they should.
[*] Fixed an issue where Scatter Sticky Bomb would not correctly count Fragmentation Sticky Bomb when determining how many times it should explode when Detonate is used.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Warrior
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where the warrior’s energy bar would bounce between 0 and 20 several times when the energy regen buff from their eternal weapon was applied.
[*] Due to addition/removal of legendary abilities from Champion and Warlord, any build utilizing these souls have been reset.
[*] Beastmaster
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Vicious Opportunity – No longer removes damage over time effects on use. Reduced bonus damage per damage over time effect by 15%. Now must follow a critical hit by the Beastmaster’s pet.
[/LIST]
[*] Champion
[LIST]
[*] Grim Satisfaction – Removed the internal cooldown on the proc.
[*] Mired – Increase damage bonus to 4/8/12%. Up from 3/6/9%.
[*] Updated Legendary Punishing Blow - Deals Physical damage per Attack Point. Increases the damage of area of effect abilities, equal to double the number of Attack Points used, by 35%. Lasts 30s
[*] Updated Legendary Dominating Bearing – Grants all Bearings. Increases damage done by 10%. Damaging single target abilities apply Domination to the enemy, for 30s, increasing the damage they take from your area of effect attacks by 125%. This bonus is half as effective on Death Blossom. Domination may only be on 1 target at a time.
[*] Removed Legendary Bull Rush.
[*] Added Legendary Power Strike –Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[/LIST]
[*] Liberator
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Liberation Treatment now also increases healing from the caster’s Liberator heals by 3% on affected allies.
[*] Legendary First Aid now applies a buff to allies over 75% health, causing them to be healed for twice the normal healing of First Aid the next time the ally takes damage.
[*] Legendary Deliverance is now instant cast.
[*] Legendary Medical Facility now Deliverance and Fast Relief splash 50% of their initial healing in an area around affected targets. Removes the cast time for Deliverance and Fast Relief. Removes the Attack Point requirement for Deliverance. Awards 2 Attack Points. Lasts 6s.
[/LIST]
[*] Paladin
[LIST]
[*] Updated the description for the Light’s Favor talent to remove reference to Light’s Rapture.
[*] Updated Legendary Protector’s Fury. It will now always deal damage to attackers while active and has a 30% chance to cast Light’s Balm on the Warrior when damaged.
[*] Updated Legendary Shield Defense. Will not automatically proc if Shield Defense is on cooldown. Automatic procs reduce damage by 25% for 10s. Can occur once per minute.
[*] Sanctuary is now an instant ability and is no longer channeled. Overall duration has not changed.
[/LIST]
[*] Paragon
[LIST]
[*] Force of Will – Now also increases crit damage of Follow Up Attacks by an additional 3/6/9%.
[*] Turn the Blade – Reduced the damage and healing penalty to 20%.
[*] Analyze Weakness – Now reduces the damage and healing penalty from Turn the Blade to 15/10% for Paragon abilities.
[*] Weapon Master – Now also reduces the cooldown of Flurry by 7.5/15s.
[*] Updated both the description and the function of Shifting Blades. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.
[*] Updated Precision Strikes to, “Increases the damage of Swift Strike and Setting Moon by 10/20%. Hitting with Swift Strike or Setting Moon applies Precision Strike to the enemy, increasing damage from your finishers and channeled abilities by 10/20% for 6s.”
[*] Fixed an issue with the debuff tooltip for Precise Strikes. It now correctly shows the amount of damage increase it gives.
[*] One Two Punch now also increases the Attack Power and Weapon Damage contribution of non-Follow Up Builders by 5%.
[*] Renamed the debuff applied by Precise Strikes from Precision Strikes to Pinpoint Targeting.
[*] Increased the duration of Pinpoint Targeting to 20s. Up from 6s.
[*] Legendary Rising Waterfall now has the second strike occur 100% of the time. Additional strikes beyond that have a 40% chance of occurring, maximum of 3 total additional strikes.
[*] Legendary Flurry now awards 3 Attack Points over its duration, deals the same damage as the normal version of Flurry, and applies a debuff to the enemy at the end of the channel which increases the damage of the next 2 Follow Up attacks by 50%.
[*] Readiness buff stacks from Legendary Unleashed now only reduce the cooldown of damaging abilities.
[*] Updated Legendary Swift Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to the enemy for 30s, causing your abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1.
[/LIST]
[*] Reaver
[LIST]
[*] Shadow of Dread now also applies a debuff to the enemy for 15s causing the enemy to take damage equal to 3% of the caster’s attack power each time the caster applies a Reaver DoT to the enemy. The debuff is applied before the DoT effects from Shadow of Dread and is also triggered by DoT refreshes from Septic Wounds.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Desecrating Blow from refreshing Reaver DoT effects with the Septic Wounds talent.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Flesh Rot from correctly gaining the bonus from Legendary Shadow of Dread when refreshed by Dire Blow or Desecrating Blow, via Septic Wounds.
[*] Updated Legendary Ravaging Strike – Deals Death damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[/LIST]
[*] Riftblade
[LIST]
[*] Elemental Flux – Increased the Blade buff proc chance bonus to 5/10/15/20/25%.
[*] Burst Synergy – Reduced cooldown from 1 min to 45s.
[*] Improved Frost Strike – Now also increases damage from Finishers by 5/10%.
[*] Elemental Caress – Now increases damage by 3/6%. Up from 2/4%.
[*] Intensify – Modified to, “Increases Critical Hit Chance by 2/4/6% and Critical Hit Damage by 5/10/15%.
[*] Enhanced Burst – Now also adds a 25% chance for hitting with a Burst ability to award 1/2 combo points.
[*] Increased the damage bonus of Planar Blade to 20%. Up from 10%.
[*] Updated how Elemental Weapon is applied to Elemental Touch.
[*] Increased damage from Elemental Touch to 6% of the Warrior’s attack power. Up from 3%.
[*] Legendary Flamespear – Duration reduced to 10s, down from 15s. Total damage dealt remains the same. Bonus damage procs can now be triggered by any damaging ability or autoattack.
[*] Fixed an issue with Legendary Flamespear retaining the benefit of all buffs active when it was cast for its full duration, even if those buffs expire before Legendary Flamespear’s debuff.
[*] Legendary Flamespear’s debuff will no longer proc off of other procs.
[/LIST]
[*] Tempest
[LIST]
[*] Updated both the description and the function of Arc. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.
[*] Updated Legendary Shock Pulse – Deals Air damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Legendary Double Pulse can now be used after any other damaging Tempest Pulse ability. It now has a 5s cooldown. Wavelength reduces this cooldown to 0.
[*] Lightning Rod, from Legendary Skyfall, can now hit the same target as Skyfall.
[*] Increased the range of Legendary Shock Pulse back to 30.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of Legendary Double Pulse to 3s.
[*] Increased the damage of Legendary Double Pulse over that of the normal Double Pulse.
[*] Removed an extra % from the end of Legendary Wavelength’s ability description.
[*] Legendary Double Pulse is now automatically cast each time a Tempest Pulse ability, other than Double Pulse, is used. It can still be cast normally after Charged Pulse is used.
[*] Legendary Skyfall will now hit all enemies between the caster and their target, including the target. Up from a limit of 3.
[*] Slightly increased the width of the lightning rod effect from Legendary Skyfall (~30% increase).
[*] Updated the ability description of Legendary Lightning Torrent for better clarity.
[/LIST]
[*] Warchanter
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where warriors would have negative regen with their eternal weapon equipped and the Warchanter buff Deep Breaths active.
[*] Updated Legendary Seasoned Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Legendary Turn the Tide now converts overhealing from the ability into an absorb shield.
[*] Legendary I’m With You! now has its healing increased by 50% on allies affected by Stand Tall!. It now awards 3 Attack Points regardless of target.
[*] Legendary We Won’t Falter! now has a base 1s cast time. 50% of overhealing done on an ally affected by the caster’s Stand Tall! is reapplied to the ally after 1.5s.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlord
[LIST]
[*] Reduced the duration of the DoT from Arterial Strike to 6s. The total damage dealt by the DoT remains the same.
[*] Updated the Wave of Steel ability description to show how much damage bonus is gained if the ability is used after a Warlord Finisher.
[*] Three Moves Ahead now increases Wave of Steel and Piercing Thrust damage by 10/20/30%. Up from 5/15/25%.
[*] Combat Training now increases damage by 5/10%. Up from 2/5%.
[*] The Advance Planning buff from King of the Hill now also affects Decisive Strike.
[*] Removed talent Defensive Surge.
[*] New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.
[*] Updated Backhand – Deals Physical damage. Weapon damage contribution is increased by 50% for each Attack Point you have on use. Blocking or Dodging an attack will reset the cooldown of Backhand. 10s cooldown.
[*] Updated the description of the talent, Calculating. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
[*] Updated the description of the talent, Seasoned. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
[*] Updated Legendary Everything is a Weapon – Using a Finisher increases the damage of your next 2 non-Finisher attacks by 100%. Up from 1.
[*] Updated Legendary Ready Posture – Increases damage done by 20%. Increases Critical Hit damage and healing by 10%. Reduces ability cost by 15%. Increases the damage of Piercing Thrust by an additional 150% when used after a Warlord Finisher. Dealing damage has a chance to increase the damage of your next A Quick Death by 300%.
[*] Updated Legendary Breaking Blow – Consumes Attack Points. 20 Power cost. Deals weapon damage plus additional damage per Attack Point. Debuffs the enemy, causing a number of your attacks equal to Attack Points consumed to ignore 10% of the enemy’s Armor. 1 point: Breaking Blow ignores 15% Armor, 2 points: Breaking Blow ignores 30% Armor, 3 points: Breaking Blow ignores 50% Armor.
[*] Removed Legendary Sergeant’s Orders.
[*] Added Legendary Empowering Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Removed talent Defensive Surge.
[*] New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.
[*] Increased damage bonus from Down and Dirty to 5/10%. Up from 3/6%.
[*] Changed Legendary Breaking Blow to apply its debuff for 2s per Attack Point consumed instead of for a set number of attacks.
[/LIST]
[*] Void Knight
[LIST]
[*] Removed Legendary Void Propulsion.
[*] Added Legendary Spark - Forces the enemy to attack the Warrior for 3s. Affected enemies deal 10% less damage to the Warrior for 4s. Applies 1 Pact to the Warrior. This can trigger Power Leech.
[*] Due to addition and removal of Legendary abilities from the Void Knight soul, all builds with points spent in the soul have had their talent points refunded.

tags.bug: - Fixed a bug that would not allow you to move items directly from your shard vault to your bank.

- Fixed an issue causing many procs to incorrectly proc other procs. This has been a long-standing issue and may result in some abilities or procs no longer interacting with other buffs and effects as they have previously. We’ll continue to monitor abilities for any unintended side effects. If you believe you’ve found one, please let us know on the forums!

tags.balance_change: - Flame of Life – Adjusted stacking priority for Flame of Life and Legendary Flame of Life to correctly reflect the damage reduction provided by the ability.
- Legendary Flash of the Phoenix now has its cooldown reduced to 30s, and no longer triggers the shared combat rez cooldown, if cast on a living ally.
- Bonus Rune of Smiting damage from Legendary Seal of Vulnerability can now only be triggered by the Seal’s original caster.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, could occasionally refresh a normal Seal of Vulnerability with the legendary version.
- Fixed another issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, would refresh Seal of Pain with Seal of Vulnerability instead.
- Fixed a minor issue where an extra debuff effect would appear on the target momentarily when Seal of Enhancement was cast.
- Fixed an issue with Eldritch Armor where Bloom would consume the reactive buff.
- Fixed an issue preventing the cast time reduction from Harbinger’s Eldritch Armor proc from affecting Bloom or Flourish if less than 2 points have been spent in Healing Slipstream.

tags.balance_change: - Tempest Winds no longer requires a Blade buff.
- Updated Lightning Charge to provide the same damage proc from Slashing attacks as Lightning Blade.

tags.feature: - New Ability: Luminous Blessing – This is a copy of the Luminous Weapon ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained at the same time you gain Luminous Weapon.

- New Ability: Reaper’s Essence – This is a copy of the Reaper’s Blade ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained when you gain Reaper’s Blade. There is also a Legendary version of this ability that is gained whenever Legendary Reaper’s Blade is selected.

tags.balance_change: - Legendary Reaper’s Blade and Legendary Reaper’s Essence now grant their damage bonus for the full duration of the buff instead of as a proc when an enemy dies.

tags.feature: - The wardrobe appearance “Crumbling Ivory Magus Bow” is now unlocked for any account that has purchased the Mystic Archer class.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue preventing Arcane Summoning from working correctly when multiple Mages with the talent are attacking the same target. This talent should now work independently for each Mage.

tags.balance_change: - Legendary Reaper’s Touch – This now causes the Mage’s pet’s damaging abilities to apply 2 additional stacks of Deathly Calling while Reaper’s Touch is active.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where if the enemy had more than 5 stacks of Deathly Calling, Desecrate would only deal damage as though there were 5 stacks and then remove all Deathly Calling stacks. Desecrate will now deal damage correctly based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy.

tags.balance_change: - Removed Legendary Grave Rot.

tags.feature: - Added Legendary Desecrate – Deals Death damage based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy. Curses the enemy for 20s, increasing damage taken from the Mage’s pet by 5% per stack of Deathly Calling on the enemy when Desecrate is cast.

tags.balance_change: - Due to the removal of Legendary Grave Rot, all builds using the Necromancer soul have had their talent points refunded.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue that would prevent Lich Form from being cast.
- Fixed an issue when a Mage has both Legendary Condemn and Legendary Reaper’s Touch, Deathly Calling would not stack higher than 5 while Legendary Reaper’s Touch was active.

tags.balance_change: - Increased the duration of Legendary Reaper’s Touch to 16s. Increased damage of both the damage over time portion and the damage burst at the end.
- Putrify now causes the Necromancer pet to apply the maximum number of stacks of Deathly Calling to the enemy. (i.e. It will now apply 10 stacks if you have Legendary Condemn).
- Legendary Condemn now also increases the Mage’s damage to the enemy by 1% per stack.

- Updated the talent description for Pyromancer’s Vengeance to accurately reflect how the talent functions. It now indicates it increases the proc chance of Pyromancer’s Blessing by 2/4% per stack instead of 1 / 2% per stack. This is only a change to the tooltip and does not affect talent or ability functionality.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where Wind Chill would consume a stack from Pyromancer’s Internalize Charge.
- Fixed an issue preventing multiple Mages from having Lingering Torment, from Legendary Neddra’s Grasp, active on an enemy at the same time.

tags.balance_change: - Legendary Life Leech – Updated the ability description to indicate the percent chance for non-warlock abilities to refresh Life Leech.

tags.bug: - The Oracle buff Inspiration of Survival is no longer able to overwrite Motif of Regeneration.

- Fixed several issues with Legendary Rapid Fire Shot. Fixed an issue allowing each use of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot on the same target to provide a multiplicative bonus to all subsequent casts of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot from other Rogues for the duration of the attack. Fixed an issue with damage interval timing.

tags.balance_change: - Updated Legendary Rapid Fire Shot to deal damage more closely matching numbers in the ability description.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where Detonate would cause Scatter Sticky Bomb to deal damage twice as many times as they should.
- Fixed an issue where Scatter Sticky Bomb would not correctly count Fragmentation Sticky Bomb when determining how many times it should explode when Detonate is used.
- Fixed an issue where the warrior’s energy bar would bounce between 0 and 20 several times when the energy regen buff from their eternal weapon was applied.

tags.balance_change: - Due to addition/removal of legendary abilities from Champion and Warlord, any build utilizing these souls have been reset.
- Legendary Vicious Opportunity – No longer removes damage over time effects on use. Reduced bonus damage per damage over time effect by 15%. Now must follow a critical hit by the Beastmaster’s pet.
- Grim Satisfaction – Removed the internal cooldown on the proc.
- Mired – Increase damage bonus to 4/8/12%. Up from 3/6/9%.
- Updated Legendary Punishing Blow - Deals Physical damage per Attack Point. Increases the damage of area of effect abilities, equal to double the number of Attack Points used, by 35%. Lasts 30s

- Updated Legendary Dominating Bearing – Grants all Bearings. Increases damage done by 10%. Damaging single target abilities apply Domination to the enemy, for 30s, increasing the damage they take from your area of effect attacks by 125%. This bonus is half as effective on Death Blossom. Domination may only be on 1 target at a time.
- Removed Legendary Bull Rush.

tags.feature: - Added Legendary Power Strike –Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.

tags.balance_change: - Legendary Liberation Treatment now also increases healing from the caster’s Liberator heals by 3% on affected allies.
- Legendary First Aid now applies a buff to allies over 75% health, causing them to be healed for twice the normal healing of First Aid the next time the ally takes damage.
- Legendary Deliverance is now instant cast.

- Legendary Medical Facility now Deliverance and Fast Relief splash 50% of their initial healing in an area around affected targets. Removes the cast time for Deliverance and Fast Relief. Removes the Attack Point requirement for Deliverance. Awards 2 Attack Points. Lasts 6s.
- Updated the description for the Light’s Favor talent to remove reference to Light’s Rapture.
- Updated Legendary Protector’s Fury. It will now always deal damage to attackers while active and has a 30% chance to cast Light’s Balm on the Warrior when damaged.
- Updated Legendary Shield Defense. Will not automatically proc if Shield Defense is on cooldown. Automatic procs reduce damage by 25% for 10s. Can occur once per minute.
- Sanctuary is now an instant ability and is no longer channeled. Overall duration has not changed.
- Force of Will – Now also increases crit damage of Follow Up Attacks by an additional 3/6/9%.
- Turn the Blade – Reduced the damage and healing penalty to 20%.
- Analyze Weakness – Now reduces the damage and healing penalty from Turn the Blade to 15/10% for Paragon abilities.
- Weapon Master – Now also reduces the cooldown of Flurry by 7.5/15s.

- Updated both the description and the function of Shifting Blades. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.

- Updated Precision Strikes to, “Increases the damage of Swift Strike and Setting Moon by 10/20%. Hitting with Swift Strike or Setting Moon applies Precision Strike to the enemy, increasing damage from your finishers and channeled abilities by 10/20% for 6s.”

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue with the debuff tooltip for Precise Strikes. It now correctly shows the amount of damage increase it gives.

tags.balance_change: - One Two Punch now also increases the Attack Power and Weapon Damage contribution of non-Follow Up Builders by 5%.
- Renamed the debuff applied by Precise Strikes from Precision Strikes to Pinpoint Targeting.
- Increased the duration of Pinpoint Targeting to 20s. Up from 6s.
- Legendary Rising Waterfall now has the second strike occur 100% of the time. Additional strikes beyond that have a 40% chance of occurring, maximum of 3 total additional strikes.

- Legendary Flurry now awards 3 Attack Points over its duration, deals the same damage as the normal version of Flurry, and applies a debuff to the enemy at the end of the channel which increases the damage of the next 2 Follow Up attacks by 50%.
- Readiness buff stacks from Legendary Unleashed now only reduce the cooldown of damaging abilities.

- Updated Legendary Swift Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to the enemy for 30s, causing your abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1.

- Shadow of Dread now also applies a debuff to the enemy for 15s causing the enemy to take damage equal to 3% of the caster’s attack power each time the caster applies a Reaver DoT to the enemy. The debuff is applied before the DoT effects from Shadow of Dread and is also triggered by DoT refreshes from Septic Wounds.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue preventing Desecrating Blow from refreshing Reaver DoT effects with the Septic Wounds talent.
- Fixed an issue preventing Flesh Rot from correctly gaining the bonus from Legendary Shadow of Dread when refreshed by Dire Blow or Desecrating Blow, via Septic Wounds.

tags.balance_change: - Updated Legendary Ravaging Strike – Deals Death damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
- Elemental Flux – Increased the Blade buff proc chance bonus to 5/10/15/20/25%.
- Burst Synergy – Reduced cooldown from 1 min to 45s.
- Improved Frost Strike – Now also increases damage from Finishers by 5/10%.
- Elemental Caress – Now increases damage by 3/6%. Up from 2/4%.
- Intensify – Modified to, “Increases Critical Hit Chance by 2/4/6% and Critical Hit Damage by 5/10/15%.
- Enhanced Burst – Now also adds a 25% chance for hitting with a Burst ability to award 1/2 combo points.
- Increased the damage bonus of Planar Blade to 20%. Up from 10%.
- Updated how Elemental Weapon is applied to Elemental Touch.
- Increased damage from Elemental Touch to 6% of the Warrior’s attack power. Up from 3%.
- Legendary Flamespear – Duration reduced to 10s, down from 15s. Total damage dealt remains the same. Bonus damage procs can now be triggered by any damaging ability or autoattack.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue with Legendary Flamespear retaining the benefit of all buffs active when it was cast for its full duration, even if those buffs expire before Legendary Flamespear’s debuff.

tags.balance_change: - Legendary Flamespear’s debuff will no longer proc off of other procs.

- Updated both the description and the function of Arc. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.

- Updated Legendary Shock Pulse – Deals Air damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
- Legendary Double Pulse can now be used after any other damaging Tempest Pulse ability. It now has a 5s cooldown. Wavelength reduces this cooldown to 0.
- Lightning Rod, from Legendary Skyfall, can now hit the same target as Skyfall.
- Increased the range of Legendary Shock Pulse back to 30.
- Reduced the cooldown of Legendary Double Pulse to 3s.
- Increased the damage of Legendary Double Pulse over that of the normal Double Pulse.

tags.bug: - Removed an extra % from the end of Legendary Wavelength’s ability description.

tags.balance_change: - Legendary Double Pulse is now automatically cast each time a Tempest Pulse ability, other than Double Pulse, is used. It can still be cast normally after Charged Pulse is used.
- Legendary Skyfall will now hit all enemies between the caster and their target, including the target. Up from a limit of 3.
- Slightly increased the width of the lightning rod effect from Legendary Skyfall (~30% increase).
- Updated the ability description of Legendary Lightning Torrent for better clarity.

tags.bug: - Fixed an issue where warriors would have negative regen with their eternal weapon equipped and the Warchanter buff Deep Breaths active.

tags.balance_change: - Updated Legendary Seasoned Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
- Legendary Turn the Tide now converts overhealing from the ability into an absorb shield.
- Legendary I’m With You! now has its healing increased by 50% on allies affected by Stand Tall!. It now awards 3 Attack Points regardless of target.
- Legendary We Won’t Falter! now has a base 1s cast time. 50% of overhealing done on an ally affected by the caster’s Stand Tall! is reapplied to the ally after 1.5s.
- Reduced the duration of the DoT from Arterial Strike to 6s. The total damage dealt by the DoT remains the same.
- Updated the Wave of Steel ability description to show how much damage bonus is gained if the ability is used after a Warlord Finisher.
- Three Moves Ahead now increases Wave of Steel and Piercing Thrust damage by 10/20/30%. Up from 5/15/25%.
- Combat Training now increases damage by 5/10%. Up from 2/5%.
- The Advance Planning buff from King of the Hill now also affects Decisive Strike.
- Removed talent Defensive Surge.

tags.feature: - New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.

tags.balance_change: - Updated Backhand – Deals Physical damage. Weapon damage contribution is increased by 50% for each Attack Point you have on use. Blocking or Dodging an attack will reset the cooldown of Backhand. 10s cooldown.
- Updated the description of the talent, Calculating. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
- Updated the description of the talent, Seasoned. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
- Updated Legendary Everything is a Weapon – Using a Finisher increases the damage of your next 2 non-Finisher attacks by 100%. Up from 1.

- Updated Legendary Ready Posture – Increases damage done by 20%. Increases Critical Hit damage and healing by 10%. Reduces ability cost by 15%. Increases the damage of Piercing Thrust by an additional 150% when used after a Warlord Finisher. Dealing damage has a chance to increase the damage of your next A Quick Death by 300%.

- Updated Legendary Breaking Blow – Consumes Attack Points. 20 Power cost. Deals weapon damage plus additional damage per Attack Point. Debuffs the enemy, causing a number of your attacks equal to Attack Points consumed to ignore 10% of the enemy’s Armor. 1 point: Breaking Blow ignores 15% Armor, 2 points: Breaking Blow ignores 30% Armor, 3 points: Breaking Blow ignores 50% Armor.
- Removed Legendary Sergeant’s Orders.
