- The druids of Scarwood Reach have demanded a much bigger replanting effort this Summerfest, so there are three times the amount of trees available in the scavenger hunt.
- Reduced the amount of Summerfest fungi that were placed tantalizingly out of reach, and uncollectable.

tags.bug: - Ability tooltips should now show the accurate value.
- Fixed the incorrect tooltip on Hit for T1 Classic Raids.
- Fixed an issue that made disabling the tooltip anchor not actually disable ability tooltips.
- Fixed an incorrect tooltip for Defensive Posture.
- Fixed a bug where temporary or reactive abilities would disappear from your UI upon logging in or reloading your UI.
- Fixed issue with previewing items causing other equipment to overlap with wardrobe previews.

tags.balance_change: - Correctly leveled mobs that were too high level for zones due to prime forced mentoring.
- Zone events will have significantly more invasions spawning. Invasions are stronger verses zone population. Wardstones will be attackable by invasions sooner.
- Essence Conversion will no longer consume damage modifying buffs.

tags.bug: - Corrected the name of the Detonate damage from Scatter Sticky Bomb. Previously it was showing in combat logs as Scatter Sticky Bomb Boof.

tags.balance_change: - Updated Legendary Tactics. It can now proc, at most, every 3s. Increased damage per proc. Previously there was no internal cooldown on the damage proc.
- Updated the ability descriptions for Empowering Strike, Power Strike, Swift Strike, Ravaging Strike, Shock Pulse and Seasoned Strike to reflect the changes to Legendary Tactics.
- Increased damage buff from Empower to 10%. Up from 5%.
- Updated how bonus damage is calculated for Piercing Thrust and Wave of Steel when these abilities are used after a Warlord finisher.

notes.title: RIFT 4.5 Update 7/11/2018 (Live)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/f1a970bf9bbcc6f2be6e0cc8ac735ce36df7ae9c.jpg[/img]
[b]RIFT 4.5: 7/11/2018[/b]

[b]== LIVE SERVER NOTES ==[/b]
[B]ACHIEVEMENTS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] The achievement “Caught Them All (Almost) now only requires 250 minions (was 300). The previous tier of minion collecting has been reduced to 175 (was 200).
[/LIST]

[B]BANK[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a bug that would not allow you to move items directly from your shard vault to your bank.
[/LIST]

[B]CALLINGS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue causing many procs to incorrectly proc other procs. This has been a long-standing issue and may result in some abilities or procs no longer interacting with other buffs and effects as they have previously. We’ll continue to monitor abilities for any unintended side effects. If you believe you’ve found one, please let us know on the forums!
[*] Cleric
[LIST]
[*] Purifier
[LIST]
[*] Flame of Life – Adjusted stacking priority for Flame of Life and Legendary Flame of Life to correctly reflect the damage reduction provided by the ability.
[*] Legendary Flash of the Phoenix now has its cooldown reduced to 30s, and no longer triggers the shared combat rez cooldown, if cast on a living ally.
[/LIST]
[*] Runeshaper
[LIST]
[*] Bonus Rune of Smiting damage from Legendary Seal of Vulnerability can now only be triggered by the Seal’s original caster. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, could occasionally refresh a normal Seal of Vulnerability with the legendary version. 
[*] Fixed another issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, would refresh Seal of Pain with Seal of Vulnerability instead. 
[*] Fixed a minor issue where an extra debuff effect would appear on the target momentarily when Seal of Enhancement was cast.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Mage
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with Eldritch Armor where Bloom would consume the reactive buff.
[*] Chloromancer
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the cast time reduction from Harbinger’s Eldritch Armor proc from affecting Bloom or Flourish if less than 2 points have been spent in Healing Slipstream.
[/LIST]
[*] Harbinger
[LIST]
[*] Tempest Winds no longer requires a Blade buff.
[*] Updated Lightning Charge to provide the same damage proc from Slashing attacks as Lightning Blade.
[*] New Ability: Luminous Blessing – This is a copy of the Luminous Weapon ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained at the same time you gain Luminous Weapon.
[*] New Ability: Reaper’s Essence – This is a copy of the Reaper’s Blade ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained when you gain Reaper’s Blade. There is also a Legendary version of this ability that is gained whenever Legendary Reaper’s Blade is selected.
[*] Legendary Reaper’s Blade and Legendary Reaper’s Essence now grant their damage bonus for the full duration of the buff instead of as a proc when an enemy dies.
[/LIST]
[*] Mystic Archer
[LIST]
[*] The wardrobe appearance “Crumbling Ivory Magus Bow” is now unlocked for any account that has purchased the Mystic Archer class.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Arcane Summoning from working correctly when multiple Mages with the talent are attacking the same target. This talent should now work independently for each Mage.
[/LIST]
[*] Necromancer
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Reaper’s Touch – This now causes the Mage’s pet’s damaging abilities to apply 2 additional stacks of Deathly Calling while Reaper’s Touch is active.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the enemy had more than 5 stacks of Deathly Calling, Desecrate would only deal damage as though there were 5 stacks and then remove all Deathly Calling stacks. Desecrate will now deal damage correctly based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy.
[*] Removed Legendary Grave Rot.
[*] Added Legendary Desecrate – Deals Death damage based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy. Curses the enemy for 20s, increasing damage taken from the Mage’s pet by 5% per stack of Deathly Calling on the enemy when Desecrate is cast.
[*] Due to the removal of Legendary Grave Rot, all builds using the Necromancer soul have had their talent points refunded.
[*] Fixed an issue that would prevent Lich Form from being cast.
[*] Fixed an issue when a Mage has both Legendary Condemn and Legendary Reaper’s Touch, Deathly Calling would not stack higher than 5 while Legendary Reaper’s Touch was active.
[*] Increased the duration of Legendary Reaper’s Touch to 16s. Increased damage of both the damage over time portion and the damage burst at the end.
[*] Putrify now causes the Necromancer pet to apply the maximum number of stacks of Deathly Calling to the enemy. (i.e. It will now apply 10 stacks if you have Legendary Condemn).
[*] Legendary Condemn now also increases the Mage’s damage to the enemy by 1% per stack.
[/LIST]
[*] Pyromancer
[LIST]
[*] Updated the talent description for Pyromancer’s Vengeance to accurately reflect how the talent functions. It now indicates it increases the proc chance of Pyromancer’s Blessing by 2/4% per stack instead of 1 / 2% per stack. This is only a change to the tooltip and does not affect talent or ability functionality.
[/LIST]
[*] Stormcaller
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Wind Chill would consume a stack from Pyromancer’s Internalize Charge.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlock
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue preventing multiple Mages from having Lingering Torment, from Legendary Neddra’s Grasp, active on an enemy at the same time.
[*] Legendary Life Leech – Updated the ability description to indicate the percent chance for non-warlock abilities to refresh Life Leech.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Primalist
[LIST]
[*] Farseer
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where the guild perk, “Call of the Ascended” was not resetting the ability “Materialize Soul”.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Rogue
[LIST]
[*] Bard
[LIST]
[*] The Oracle buff Inspiration of Survival is no longer able to overwrite Motif of Regeneration.
[/LIST]
[*] Marksman
[LIST]
[*] Fixed several issues with Legendary Rapid Fire Shot. Fixed an issue allowing each use of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot on the same target to provide a multiplicative bonus to all subsequent casts of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot from other Rogues for the duration of the attack. Fixed an issue with damage interval timing.
[*] Updated Legendary Rapid Fire Shot to deal damage more closely matching numbers in the ability description.
[/LIST]
[*] Saboteur
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where Detonate would cause Scatter Sticky Bomb to deal damage twice as many times as they should.
[*] Fixed an issue where Scatter Sticky Bomb would not correctly count Fragmentation Sticky Bomb when determining how many times it should explode when Detonate is used.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Warrior
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where the warrior’s energy bar would bounce between 0 and 20 several times when the energy regen buff from their eternal weapon was applied.
[*] Due to addition/removal of legendary abilities from Champion and Warlord, any build utilizing these souls have been reset.
[*] Beastmaster
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Vicious Opportunity – No longer removes damage over time effects on use. Reduced bonus damage per damage over time effect by 15%. Now must follow a critical hit by the Beastmaster’s pet.
[/LIST]
[*] Champion
[LIST]
[*] Grim Satisfaction – Removed the internal cooldown on the proc.
[*] Mired – Increase damage bonus to 4/8/12%. Up from 3/6/9%.
[*] Updated Legendary Punishing Blow - Deals Physical damage per Attack Point. Increases the damage of area of effect abilities, equal to double the number of Attack Points used, by 35%. Lasts 30s
[*] Updated Legendary Dominating Bearing – Grants all Bearings. Increases damage done by 10%. Damaging single target abilities apply Domination to the enemy, for 30s, increasing the damage they take from your area of effect attacks by 125%. This bonus is half as effective on Death Blossom. Domination may only be on 1 target at a time.
[*] Removed Legendary Bull Rush.
[*] Added Legendary Power Strike –Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[/LIST]
[*] Liberator
[LIST]
[*] Legendary Liberation Treatment now also increases healing from the caster’s Liberator heals by 3% on affected allies.
[*] Legendary First Aid now applies a buff to allies over 75% health, causing them to be healed for twice the normal healing of First Aid the next time the ally takes damage.
[*] Legendary Deliverance is now instant cast.
[*] Legendary Medical Facility now Deliverance and Fast Relief splash 50% of their initial healing in an area around affected targets. Removes the cast time for Deliverance and Fast Relief. Removes the Attack Point requirement for Deliverance. Awards 2 Attack Points. Lasts 6s.
[/LIST]
[*] Paladin
[LIST]
[*] Updated the description for the Light’s Favor talent to remove reference to Light’s Rapture.
[*] Updated Legendary Protector’s Fury. It will now always deal damage to attackers while active and has a 30% chance to cast Light’s Balm on the Warrior when damaged.
[*] Updated Legendary Shield Defense. Will not automatically proc if Shield Defense is on cooldown. Automatic procs reduce damage by 25% for 10s. Can occur once per minute.
[*] Sanctuary is now an instant ability and is no longer channeled. Overall duration has not changed.
[/LIST]
[*] Paragon
[LIST]
[*] Force of Will – Now also increases crit damage of Follow Up Attacks by an additional 3/6/9%.
[*] Turn the Blade – Reduced the damage and healing penalty to 20%.
[*] Analyze Weakness – Now reduces the damage and healing penalty from Turn the Blade to 15/10% for Paragon abilities.
[*] Weapon Master – Now also reduces the cooldown of Flurry by 7.5/15s.
[*] Updated both the description and the function of Shifting Blades. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.
[*] Updated Precision Strikes to, “Increases the damage of Swift Strike and Setting Moon by 10/20%. Hitting with Swift Strike or Setting Moon applies Precision Strike to the enemy, increasing damage from your finishers and channeled abilities by 10/20% for 6s.”
[*] Fixed an issue with the debuff tooltip for Precise Strikes. It now correctly shows the amount of damage increase it gives.
[*] One Two Punch now also increases the Attack Power and Weapon Damage contribution of non-Follow Up Builders by 5%.
[*] Renamed the debuff applied by Precise Strikes from Precision Strikes to Pinpoint Targeting.
[*] Increased the duration of Pinpoint Targeting to 20s. Up from 6s.
[*] Legendary Rising Waterfall now has the second strike occur 100% of the time. Additional strikes beyond that have a 40% chance of occurring, maximum of 3 total additional strikes.
[*] Legendary Flurry now awards 3 Attack Points over its duration, deals the same damage as the normal version of Flurry, and applies a debuff to the enemy at the end of the channel which increases the damage of the next 2 Follow Up attacks by 50%.
[*] Readiness buff stacks from Legendary Unleashed now only reduce the cooldown of damaging abilities.
[*] Updated Legendary Swift Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to the enemy for 30s, causing your abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1.
[/LIST]
[*] Reaver
[LIST]
[*] Shadow of Dread now also applies a debuff to the enemy for 15s causing the enemy to take damage equal to 3% of the caster’s attack power each time the caster applies a Reaver DoT to the enemy. The debuff is applied before the DoT effects from Shadow of Dread and is also triggered by DoT refreshes from Septic Wounds.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Desecrating Blow from refreshing Reaver DoT effects with the Septic Wounds talent.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Flesh Rot from correctly gaining the bonus from Legendary Shadow of Dread when refreshed by Dire Blow or Desecrating Blow, via Septic Wounds.
[*] Updated Legendary Ravaging Strike – Deals Death damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[/LIST]
[*] Riftblade
[LIST]
[*] Elemental Flux – Increased the Blade buff proc chance bonus to 5/10/15/20/25%.
[*] Burst Synergy – Reduced cooldown from 1 min to 45s.
[*] Improved Frost Strike – Now also increases damage from Finishers by 5/10%.
[*] Elemental Caress – Now increases damage by 3/6%. Up from 2/4%.
[*] Intensify – Modified to, “Increases Critical Hit Chance by 2/4/6% and Critical Hit Damage by 5/10/15%.
[*] Enhanced Burst – Now also adds a 25% chance for hitting with a Burst ability to award 1/2 combo points.
[*] Increased the damage bonus of Planar Blade to 20%. Up from 10%.
[*] Updated how Elemental Weapon is applied to Elemental Touch.
[*] Increased damage from Elemental Touch to 6% of the Warrior’s attack power. Up from 3%.
[*] Legendary Flamespear – Duration reduced to 10s, down from 15s. Total damage dealt remains the same. Bonus damage procs can now be triggered by any damaging ability or autoattack.
[*] Fixed an issue with Legendary Flamespear retaining the benefit of all buffs active when it was cast for its full duration, even if those buffs expire before Legendary Flamespear’s debuff.
[*] Legendary Flamespear’s debuff will no longer proc off of other procs.
[/LIST]
[*] Tempest
[LIST]
[*] Updated both the description and the function of Arc. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.
[*] Updated Legendary Shock Pulse – Deals Air damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Legendary Double Pulse can now be used after any other damaging Tempest Pulse ability. It now has a 5s cooldown. Wavelength reduces this cooldown to 0.
[*] Lightning Rod, from Legendary Skyfall, can now hit the same target as Skyfall.
[*] Increased the range of Legendary Shock Pulse back to 30.
[*] Reduced the cooldown of Legendary Double Pulse to 3s.
[*] Increased the damage of Legendary Double Pulse over that of the normal Double Pulse.
[*] Removed an extra % from the end of Legendary Wavelength’s ability description.
[*] Legendary Double Pulse is now automatically cast each time a Tempest Pulse ability, other than Double Pulse, is used. It can still be cast normally after Charged Pulse is used.
[*] Legendary Skyfall will now hit all enemies between the caster and their target, including the target. Up from a limit of 3.
[*] Slightly increased the width of the lightning rod effect from Legendary Skyfall (~30% increase).
[*] Updated the ability description of Legendary Lightning Torrent for better clarity.
[/LIST]
[*] Warchanter
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue where warriors would have negative regen with their eternal weapon equipped and the Warchanter buff Deep Breaths active.
[*] Updated Legendary Seasoned Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Legendary Turn the Tide now converts overhealing from the ability into an absorb shield.
[*] Legendary I’m With You! now has its healing increased by 50% on allies affected by Stand Tall!. It now awards 3 Attack Points regardless of target.
[*] Legendary We Won’t Falter! now has a base 1s cast time. 50% of overhealing done on an ally affected by the caster’s Stand Tall! is reapplied to the ally after 1.5s.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlord
[LIST]
[*] Reduced the duration of the DoT from Arterial Strike to 6s. The total damage dealt by the DoT remains the same.
[*] Updated the Wave of Steel ability description to show how much damage bonus is gained if the ability is used after a Warlord Finisher.
[*] Three Moves Ahead now increases Wave of Steel and Piercing Thrust damage by 10/20/30%. Up from 5/15/25%.
[*] Combat Training now increases damage by 5/10%. Up from 2/5%.
[*] The Advance Planning buff from King of the Hill now also affects Decisive Strike.
[*] Removed talent Defensive Surge.
[*] New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.
[*] Updated Backhand – Deals Physical damage. Weapon damage contribution is increased by 50% for each Attack Point you have on use. Blocking or Dodging an attack will reset the cooldown of Backhand. 10s cooldown.
[*] Updated the description of the talent, Calculating. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
[*] Updated the description of the talent, Seasoned. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
[*] Updated Legendary Everything is a Weapon – Using a Finisher increases the damage of your next 2 non-Finisher attacks by 100%. Up from 1.
[*] Updated Legendary Ready Posture – Increases damage done by 20%. Increases Critical Hit damage and healing by 10%. Reduces ability cost by 15%. Increases the damage of Piercing Thrust by an additional 150% when used after a Warlord Finisher. Dealing damage has a chance to increase the damage of your next A Quick Death by 300%.
[*] Updated Legendary Breaking Blow – Consumes Attack Points. 20 Power cost. Deals weapon damage plus additional damage per Attack Point. Debuffs the enemy, causing a number of your attacks equal to Attack Points consumed to ignore 10% of the enemy’s Armor. 1 point: Breaking Blow ignores 15% Armor, 2 points: Breaking Blow ignores 30% Armor, 3 points: Breaking Blow ignores 50% Armor.
[*] Removed Legendary Sergeant’s Orders.
[*] Added Legendary Empowering Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
[*] Removed talent Defensive Surge.
[*] New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.
[*] Increased damage bonus from Down and Dirty to 5/10%. Up from 3/6%.
[*] Changed Legendary Breaking Blow to apply its debuff for 2s per Attack Point consumed instead of for a set number of attacks.
[/LIST]
[*] Void Knight
[LIST]
[*] Removed Legendary Void Propulsion.
[*] Added Legendary Spark - Forces the enemy to attack the Warrior for 3s. Affected enemies deal 10% less damage to the Warrior for 4s. Applies 1 Pact to the Warrior. This can trigger Power Leech.
[*] Due to addition and removal of Legendary abilities from the Void Knight soul, all builds with points spent in the soul have had their talent points refunded.
[*] Discharge now gains 125% damage for each Pact consumed beyond the first. Up from 100%.
[*] Legendary Discharge now also gains an additional 20% increased damage for each Pact still active after the ability consumes Pacts. It now retains its cooldown, regardless of Pacts consumed.
[*] Legendary Spark now applies a visible debuff to the enemy affected by the damage reduction effect.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]GUILDS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a bug that when joining a guild, if already inside that guild’s dimension you would not be able to see their item list.
[/LIST]
[B]INSTANCES[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Runic Descent
[LIST]
[*] Fixed issue in Runic Descent and Runic Descent Expert that prevented the Rotting Blossoms spawned by Wormwood from exploding.
[/LIST]
[*] Temple of Ananke
[LIST]
[*] Players should no longer be able to pull Lord Draveneaux out of the fight space.
[/LIST]
[/list]
[B]ITEMS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Blighted Riftstalker Crystal
[LIST]
[*] The four piece set bonus has been changed due to the removal of the cooldown to Rift Disturbance. Now increases the damage of Rift Disturbance by 50.
[/LIST]
[*] Blighted Saboteur Crystal
[LIST]
[*] The four piece set bonus has been changed due to the abilities it was affecting no longer existing. Now increases the damage of Satchel Charge by 25.
[/LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Predatory Soulstone. It will now correctly apply its damage bonus to Shadow Fire.
[*] The 2-piece bonus of Nyx’s Pyromancer Crystal now reduces the duration of the damage over time effect applied by Fireball by 3s and increases the speed the effect ticks by 60%.
[*] The 2 piece bonuses from Gilded Reaver Crystal, Blighted Reaver Crystal, Blighted Warlord Crystal now awards Attack Power instead of Endurance.
[*] The 3 piece bonuses from Rasmolov's Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Luminous Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Glowing Reaver Crystal, and Rasmolov's Warlord Crystal now awards Attack Power instead of Endurance.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Rasmolov's Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation by 4s.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 6s.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Glowing Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 6s, and causes them to award an additional Attack Point.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Luminous Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 8s, and causes them to award an additional Attack Point.
[*] The 4 piece bonus from Rasmolov's Warlord Crystal and the 2 piece bonus from Blighted Warlord Crystal now causes Warlord Finishers to increase Attack Power by 60 for 15s.
[*] Updated the description of the 2 piece bonus on Asphodel's Druid Crystal to indicate the correct amount of Armor it causes Fervent Strike to ignore instead of Life resistance. 
[*] For level 70 raid gear with randomized suffixes (concats), the odds of any particular concat have been evened out.
[/LIST]
[B]LEADERBOARDS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Added leaderboards for Ghar Station Eyn Warfront.
[*] Added leaderboards for Blighted Antechamber.
[/LIST]
[B]PROFESSIONS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Removed Coruscating Ethereal Shards as a reagent in dimension item recipes.
[*] Light Goldenrod Dye no longer requires a Coruscating Ethereal Shard.
[/LIST]
[B]QUESTS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed a text error in the Orphiel’s Grave quest in Vostigar Peaks.
[*] Fixed an issue with some VO repeating in A Celestial Tale: The Devil Who Would Be King daily quest.
[*] Made some spelling corrections to quest rewards.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented ‘Hive Divided’ and ‘A Dangerous Device’ daily quests in the Chronicle: Planebreaker Bastion: Aftermath from being offered.
[*] Fixed an issue that prevented the Nightmare Coast Expert quest, ‘The stuff dreams are made of,’ from being completed.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the Faceless Man to offer the wrong quest set in Nightmare Coast (Expert). Quests in Nightmare Coast (Standard) no longer require returning to the Faceless Man for completion.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented victories in the Tenebrean Prison from counting toward for the quest, ‘To the Victor.’
[*] Added The Tenebrean Prison to the list of Warfronts where the Daily PvP quest The Starfallen can be completed.
[*] Victories in the Tenebrean Prison now count toward completion of the quest ‘By the Sword’.
[*] Fixed bugs with daily quest completion counts and made the count increment only when reward is claimed.
[/LIST]
[B]RAIDS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Bastion of Steel
[LIST]
[*] Increased drop rate of Storm Cells.
[*] Greatly increased the Legion Datagram rate.
[/LIST]
[*] Greenscale’s Blight
[LIST]
[*] Removed mana drain abilities from the raid.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Greenscale encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Prince Hylas encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Oracle Aleria encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Duke letareus encounter.
[/LIST]
[*] Gilded Prophecy
[LIST]
[*] Added encounter wall and leash radius to Uruluuk encounter.
[*] Added encounter wall to Thalguur encounter.
[*] Adjusted leash point for Anrak the Foul.
[/LIST]
[*] Drowned Halls
[LIST]
[*] Adjusted leash point for Assault Commander Jorb.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[B]SUMMERFEST[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Summerfest officially begins on Thursday, July 12, 2018 at 3:30 PM server time and runs until Thursday, August 2, 2018 at 3:30 PM server time.
[*] The druids of Scarwood Reach have demanded a much bigger replanting effort this Summerfest, so there are three times the amount of trees available in the scavenger hunt.
[*] Reduced the amount of Summerfest fungi that were placed tantalizingly out of reach, and uncollectable.
[/LIST]
[B]TOOLTIPS[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an issue that made disabling the tooltip anchor not actually disable ability tooltips.
[/LIST]
[B]UI[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Fixed an incorrect tooltip for Defensive Posture.
[*] Fixed a bug where temporary or reactive abilities would disappear from your UI upon logging in or reloading your UI.
[*] Fixed issue with previewing items causing other equipment to overlap with wardrobe previews.
[/LIST]
[B]WORLD[/B]
[LIST]
[*] Many weekly quests in Alittu now offer a choice between Tower Fragments, Ethereal Shards, and Legion Datagrams.
[*] Reduced the Captured Intel costs on a number of items.
[/LIST]

[B]Additional 4.5 Patch Notes (LIVE)[/B]

CALLINGS
[LIST]
[*] Mage
[LIST]
[*] Chloromancer
[LIST]
[*] Essence Conversion will no longer consume damage modifying buffs.
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Rogue
[LIST]
[*] Saboteur
[LIST]
[*] Corrected the name of the Detonate damage from Scatter Sticky Bomb. Previously it was showing in combat logs as Scatter Sticky Bomb Boof. 
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[*] Warrior
[LIST]
[*] Updated the ability descriptions for Empowering Strike, Power Strike, Swift Strike, Ravaging Strike, Shock Pulse and Seasoned Strike to reflect the changes to Legendary Tactics.
[*] Updated Legendary Tactics. It can now proc, at most, every 3s. Increased damage per proc. Previously there was no internal cooldown on the damage proc.
[*] Tempest
[LIST]
[*] Increased damage buff from Empower to 10%. Up from 5%.
[/LIST]
[*] Warlord
[LIST]
[*] Updated how bonus damage is calculated for Piercing Thrust and Wave of Steel when these abilities are used after a Warlord finisher. 
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
[/LIST]
ITEMS
[LIST]
[*] For level 70 raid gear with randomized suffixes (concats), the odds of any particular concat have been evened out.
[/LIST]

tags.balance_change: The achievement “Caught Them All (Almost) now only requires 250 minions (was 300). The previous tier of minion collecting has been reduced to 175 (was 200).

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that would not allow you to move items directly from your shard vault to your bank.

Fixed an issue causing many procs to incorrectly proc other procs. This has been a long-standing issue and may result in some abilities or procs no longer interacting with other buffs and effects as they have previously. We’ll continue to monitor abilities for any unintended side effects. If you believe you’ve found one, please let us know on the forums!

tags.balance_change: Flame of Life – Adjusted stacking priority for Flame of Life and Legendary Flame of Life to correctly reflect the damage reduction provided by the ability.
Legendary Flash of the Phoenix now has its cooldown reduced to 30s, and no longer triggers the shared combat rez cooldown, if cast on a living ally.

tags.bug: Bonus Rune of Smiting damage from Legendary Seal of Vulnerability can now only be triggered by the Seal’s original caster.
Fixed an issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, could occasionally refresh a normal Seal of Vulnerability with the legendary version.
Fixed another issue where Rune of Travail, with the Powered Inscription talent, would refresh Seal of Pain with Seal of Vulnerability instead.
Fixed a minor issue where an extra debuff effect would appear on the target momentarily when Seal of Enhancement was cast.
Fixed an issue with Eldritch Armor where Bloom would consume the reactive buff.
Fixed an issue preventing the cast time reduction from Harbinger’s Eldritch Armor proc from affecting Bloom or Flourish if less than 2 points have been spent in Healing Slipstream.

tags.balance_change: Tempest Winds no longer requires a Blade buff.
Updated Lightning Charge to provide the same damage proc from Slashing attacks as Lightning Blade.

tags.feature: New Ability: Luminous Blessing – This is a copy of the Luminous Weapon ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained at the same time you gain Luminous Weapon.

New Ability: Reaper’s Essence – This is a copy of the Reaper’s Blade ability, but does not transform the caster’s weapon. It is gained when you gain Reaper’s Blade. There is also a Legendary version of this ability that is gained whenever Legendary Reaper’s Blade is selected.

tags.balance_change: Legendary Reaper’s Blade and Legendary Reaper’s Essence now grant their damage bonus for the full duration of the buff instead of as a proc when an enemy dies.

tags.feature: The wardrobe appearance “Crumbling Ivory Magus Bow” is now unlocked for any account that has purchased the Mystic Archer class.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue preventing Arcane Summoning from working correctly when multiple Mages with the talent are attacking the same target. This talent should now work independently for each Mage.

tags.balance_change: Legendary Reaper’s Touch – This now causes the Mage’s pet’s damaging abilities to apply 2 additional stacks of Deathly Calling while Reaper’s Touch is active.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where if the enemy had more than 5 stacks of Deathly Calling, Desecrate would only deal damage as though there were 5 stacks and then remove all Deathly Calling stacks. Desecrate will now deal damage correctly based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy.

tags.feature: Removed Legendary Grave Rot.

Added Legendary Desecrate – Deals Death damage based on the number of stacks of Deathly Calling on the enemy. Curses the enemy for 20s, increasing damage taken from the Mage’s pet by 5% per stack of Deathly Calling on the enemy when Desecrate is cast.

tags.balance_change: Due to the removal of Legendary Grave Rot, all builds using the Necromancer soul have had their talent points refunded.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that would prevent Lich Form from being cast.
Fixed an issue when a Mage has both Legendary Condemn and Legendary Reaper’s Touch, Deathly Calling would not stack higher than 5 while Legendary Reaper’s Touch was active.

tags.balance_change: Increased the duration of Legendary Reaper’s Touch to 16s. Increased damage of both the damage over time portion and the damage burst at the end.
Putrify now causes the Necromancer pet to apply the maximum number of stacks of Deathly Calling to the enemy. (i.e. It will now apply 10 stacks if you have Legendary Condemn).
Legendary Condemn now also increases the Mage’s damage to the enemy by 1% per stack.

Updated the talent description for Pyromancer’s Vengeance to accurately reflect how the talent functions. It now indicates it increases the proc chance of Pyromancer’s Blessing by 2/4% per stack instead of 1 / 2% per stack. This is only a change to the tooltip and does not affect talent or ability functionality.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Wind Chill would consume a stack from Pyromancer’s Internalize Charge.
Fixed an issue preventing multiple Mages from having Lingering Torment, from Legendary Neddra’s Grasp, active on an enemy at the same time.

tags.balance_change: Legendary Life Leech – Updated the ability description to indicate the percent chance for non-warlock abilities to refresh Life Leech.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where the guild perk, “Call of the Ascended” was not resetting the ability “Materialize Soul”.

tags.balance_change: The Oracle buff Inspiration of Survival is no longer able to overwrite Motif of Regeneration.

tags.bug: Fixed several issues with Legendary Rapid Fire Shot. Fixed an issue allowing each use of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot on the same target to provide a multiplicative bonus to all subsequent casts of Legendary Rapid Fire Shot from other Rogues for the duration of the attack. Fixed an issue with damage interval timing.

tags.balance_change: Updated Legendary Rapid Fire Shot to deal damage more closely matching numbers in the ability description.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where Detonate would cause Scatter Sticky Bomb to deal damage twice as many times as they should.
Fixed an issue where Scatter Sticky Bomb would not correctly count Fragmentation Sticky Bomb when determining how many times it should explode when Detonate is used.
Fixed an issue where the warrior’s energy bar would bounce between 0 and 20 several times when the energy regen buff from their eternal weapon was applied.

tags.balance_change: Due to addition/removal of legendary abilities from Champion and Warlord, any build utilizing these souls have been reset.
Legendary Vicious Opportunity – No longer removes damage over time effects on use. Reduced bonus damage per damage over time effect by 15%. Now must follow a critical hit by the Beastmaster’s pet.
Grim Satisfaction – Removed the internal cooldown on the proc.
Mired – Increase damage bonus to 4/8/12%. Up from 3/6/9%.
Updated Legendary Punishing Blow - Deals Physical damage per Attack Point. Increases the damage of area of effect abilities, equal to double the number of Attack Points used, by 35%. Lasts 30s

Updated Legendary Dominating Bearing – Grants all Bearings. Increases damage done by 10%. Damaging single target abilities apply Domination to the enemy, for 30s, increasing the damage they take from your area of effect attacks by 125%. This bonus is half as effective on Death Blossom. Domination may only be on 1 target at a time.

tags.feature: Removed Legendary Bull Rush.

Added Legendary Power Strike –Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.

tags.balance_change: Legendary Liberation Treatment now also increases healing from the caster’s Liberator heals by 3% on affected allies.
Legendary First Aid now applies a buff to allies over 75% health, causing them to be healed for twice the normal healing of First Aid the next time the ally takes damage.
Legendary Deliverance is now instant cast.

Legendary Medical Facility now Deliverance and Fast Relief splash 50% of their initial healing in an area around affected targets. Removes the cast time for Deliverance and Fast Relief. Removes the Attack Point requirement for Deliverance. Awards 2 Attack Points. Lasts 6s.
Updated the description for the Light’s Favor talent to remove reference to Light’s Rapture.
Updated Legendary Protector’s Fury. It will now always deal damage to attackers while active and has a 30% chance to cast Light’s Balm on the Warrior when damaged.
Updated Legendary Shield Defense. Will not automatically proc if Shield Defense is on cooldown. Automatic procs reduce damage by 25% for 10s. Can occur once per minute.
Sanctuary is now an instant ability and is no longer channeled. Overall duration has not changed.
Force of Will – Now also increases crit damage of Follow Up Attacks by an additional 3/6/9%.
Turn the Blade – Reduced the damage and healing penalty to 20%.
Analyze Weakness – Now reduces the damage and healing penalty from Turn the Blade to 15/10% for Paragon abilities.
Weapon Master – Now also reduces the cooldown of Flurry by 7.5/15s.

Updated both the description and the function of Shifting Blades. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.

Updated Precision Strikes to, “Increases the damage of Swift Strike and Setting Moon by 10/20%. Hitting with Swift Strike or Setting Moon applies Precision Strike to the enemy, increasing damage from your finishers and channeled abilities by 10/20% for 6s.”

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the debuff tooltip for Precise Strikes. It now correctly shows the amount of damage increase it gives.

tags.balance_change: One Two Punch now also increases the Attack Power and Weapon Damage contribution of non-Follow Up Builders by 5%.
Renamed the debuff applied by Precise Strikes from Precision Strikes to Pinpoint Targeting.
Increased the duration of Pinpoint Targeting to 20s. Up from 6s.
Legendary Rising Waterfall now has the second strike occur 100% of the time. Additional strikes beyond that have a 40% chance of occurring, maximum of 3 total additional strikes.

Legendary Flurry now awards 3 Attack Points over its duration, deals the same damage as the normal version of Flurry, and applies a debuff to the enemy at the end of the channel which increases the damage of the next 2 Follow Up attacks by 50%.
Readiness buff stacks from Legendary Unleashed now only reduce the cooldown of damaging abilities.

Updated Legendary Swift Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to the enemy for 30s, causing your abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1.

Shadow of Dread now also applies a debuff to the enemy for 15s causing the enemy to take damage equal to 3% of the caster’s attack power each time the caster applies a Reaver DoT to the enemy. The debuff is applied before the DoT effects from Shadow of Dread and is also triggered by DoT refreshes from Septic Wounds.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue preventing Desecrating Blow from refreshing Reaver DoT effects with the Septic Wounds talent.
Fixed an issue preventing Flesh Rot from correctly gaining the bonus from Legendary Shadow of Dread when refreshed by Dire Blow or Desecrating Blow, via Septic Wounds.

tags.balance_change: Updated Legendary Ravaging Strike – Deals Death damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
Elemental Flux – Increased the Blade buff proc chance bonus to 5/10/15/20/25%.
Burst Synergy – Reduced cooldown from 1 min to 45s.
Improved Frost Strike – Now also increases damage from Finishers by 5/10%.
Elemental Caress – Now increases damage by 3/6%. Up from 2/4%.
Intensify – Modified to, “Increases Critical Hit Chance by 2/4/6% and Critical Hit Damage by 5/10/15%.
Enhanced Burst – Now also adds a 25% chance for hitting with a Burst ability to award 1/2 combo points.
Increased the damage bonus of Planar Blade to 20%. Up from 10%.
Updated how Elemental Weapon is applied to Elemental Touch.
Increased damage from Elemental Touch to 6% of the Warrior’s attack power. Up from 3%.
Legendary Flamespear – Duration reduced to 10s, down from 15s. Total damage dealt remains the same. Bonus damage procs can now be triggered by any damaging ability or autoattack.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with Legendary Flamespear retaining the benefit of all buffs active when it was cast for its full duration, even if those buffs expire before Legendary Flamespear’s debuff.

tags.balance_change: Legendary Flamespear’s debuff will no longer proc off of other procs.

Updated both the description and the function of Arc. The ability should now function as the description indicates. This results in a small increase in damage over how the ability functioned previously.

Updated Legendary Shock Pulse – Deals Air damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
Legendary Double Pulse can now be used after any other damaging Tempest Pulse ability. It now has a 5s cooldown. Wavelength reduces this cooldown to 0.
Lightning Rod, from Legendary Skyfall, can now hit the same target as Skyfall.
Increased the range of Legendary Shock Pulse back to 30.
Reduced the cooldown of Legendary Double Pulse to 3s.
Increased the damage of Legendary Double Pulse over that of the normal Double Pulse.

tags.bug: Removed an extra % from the end of Legendary Wavelength’s ability description.

tags.balance_change: Legendary Double Pulse is now automatically cast each time a Tempest Pulse ability, other than Double Pulse, is used. It can still be cast normally after Charged Pulse is used.
Legendary Skyfall will now hit all enemies between the caster and their target, including the target. Up from a limit of 3.
Slightly increased the width of the lightning rod effect from Legendary Skyfall (~30% increase).
Updated the ability description of Legendary Lightning Torrent for better clarity.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where warriors would have negative regen with their eternal weapon equipped and the Warchanter buff Deep Breaths active.

tags.balance_change: Updated Legendary Seasoned Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
Legendary Turn the Tide now converts overhealing from the ability into an absorb shield.
Legendary I’m With You! now has its healing increased by 50% on allies affected by Stand Tall!. It now awards 3 Attack Points regardless of target.
Legendary We Won’t Falter! now has a base 1s cast time. 50% of overhealing done on an ally affected by the caster’s Stand Tall! is reapplied to the ally after 1.5s.
Reduced the duration of the DoT from Arterial Strike to 6s. The total damage dealt by the DoT remains the same.
Updated the Wave of Steel ability description to show how much damage bonus is gained if the ability is used after a Warlord Finisher.
Three Moves Ahead now increases Wave of Steel and Piercing Thrust damage by 10/20/30%. Up from 5/15/25%.
Combat Training now increases damage by 5/10%. Up from 2/5%.
The Advance Planning buff from King of the Hill now also affects Decisive Strike.

tags.feature: Removed talent Defensive Surge.
New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.

tags.balance_change: Updated Backhand – Deals Physical damage. Weapon damage contribution is increased by 50% for each Attack Point you have on use. Blocking or Dodging an attack will reset the cooldown of Backhand. 10s cooldown.
Updated the description of the talent, Calculating. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
Updated the description of the talent, Seasoned. It now just lists Backhand instead of “all attacks that must follow a Block or Dodge”.
Updated Legendary Everything is a Weapon – Using a Finisher increases the damage of your next 2 non-Finisher attacks by 100%. Up from 1.

Updated Legendary Ready Posture – Increases damage done by 20%. Increases Critical Hit damage and healing by 10%. Reduces ability cost by 15%. Increases the damage of Piercing Thrust by an additional 150% when used after a Warlord Finisher. Dealing damage has a chance to increase the damage of your next A Quick Death by 300%.

Updated Legendary Breaking Blow – Consumes Attack Points. 20 Power cost. Deals weapon damage plus additional damage per Attack Point. Debuffs the enemy, causing a number of your attacks equal to Attack Points consumed to ignore 10% of the enemy’s Armor. 1 point: Breaking Blow ignores 15% Armor, 2 points: Breaking Blow ignores 30% Armor, 3 points: Breaking Blow ignores 50% Armor.

tags.feature: Removed Legendary Sergeant’s Orders.

Added Legendary Empowering Strike – Deals Physical damage. Applies a stack of Legendary Tactics to you for 30s, causing your damaging abilities and autoattacks to deal additional Ethereal damage. Increases the stack size of Legendary Tactics by 1. Awards 1 Attack Point.
Removed talent Defensive Surge.
New talent: Executioner – Increases the health threshold A Quick Death can be used at by 40%.

tags.balance_change: Increased damage bonus from Down and Dirty to 5/10%. Up from 3/6%.
Changed Legendary Breaking Blow to apply its debuff for 2s per Attack Point consumed instead of for a set number of attacks.

tags.feature: Removed Legendary Void Propulsion.
Added Legendary Spark - Forces the enemy to attack the Warrior for 3s. Affected enemies deal 10% less damage to the Warrior for 4s. Applies 1 Pact to the Warrior. This can trigger Power Leech.

tags.balance_change: Due to addition and removal of Legendary abilities from the Void Knight soul, all builds with points spent in the soul have had their talent points refunded.
Discharge now gains 125% damage for each Pact consumed beyond the first. Up from 100%.
Legendary Discharge now also gains an additional 20% increased damage for each Pact still active after the ability consumes Pacts. It now retains its cooldown, regardless of Pacts consumed.
Legendary Spark now applies a visible debuff to the enemy affected by the damage reduction effect.

tags.bug: Fixed a bug that when joining a guild, if already inside that guild’s dimension you would not be able to see their item list.
Fixed issue in Runic Descent and Runic Descent Expert that prevented the Rotting Blossoms spawned by Wormwood from exploding.
Players should no longer be able to pull Lord Draveneaux out of the fight space.

tags.balance_change: The four piece set bonus has been changed due to the removal of the cooldown to Rift Disturbance. Now increases the damage of Rift Disturbance by 50.
The four piece set bonus has been changed due to the abilities it was affecting no longer existing. Now increases the damage of Satchel Charge by 25.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue with the Predatory Soulstone. It will now correctly apply its damage bonus to Shadow Fire.

tags.balance_change: The 2-piece bonus of Nyx’s Pyromancer Crystal now reduces the duration of the damage over time effect applied by Fireball by 3s and increases the speed the effect ticks by 60%.
The 2 piece bonuses from Gilded Reaver Crystal, Blighted Reaver Crystal, Blighted Warlord Crystal now awards Attack Power instead of Endurance.

The 3 piece bonuses from Rasmolov's Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Luminous Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Reaver Crystal, Calliope's Glowing Reaver Crystal, and Rasmolov's Warlord Crystal now awards Attack Power instead of Endurance.
The 4 piece bonus from Rasmolov's Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation by 4s.
The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 6s.
The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Glowing Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 6s, and causes them to award an additional Attack Point.
The 4 piece bonus from Calliope's Luminous Reaver Crystal now reduces the cooldown of Infestation and Explosive Infestation by 8s, and causes them to award an additional Attack Point.
The 4 piece bonus from Rasmolov's Warlord Crystal and the 2 piece bonus from Blighted Warlord Crystal now causes Warlord Finishers to increase Attack Power by 60 for 15s.
Updated the description of the 2 piece bonus on Asphodel's Druid Crystal to indicate the correct amount of Armor it causes Fervent Strike to ignore instead of Life resistance.
For level 70 raid gear with randomized suffixes (concats), the odds of any particular concat have been evened out.

tags.feature: Added leaderboards for Ghar Station Eyn Warfront.
Added leaderboards for Blighted Antechamber.

tags.balance_change: Removed Coruscating Ethereal Shards as a reagent in dimension item recipes.
Light Goldenrod Dye no longer requires a Coruscating Ethereal Shard.

tags.bug: Fixed a text error in the Orphiel’s Grave quest in Vostigar Peaks.
Fixed an issue with some VO repeating in A Celestial Tale: The Devil Who Would Be King daily quest.
Made some spelling corrections to quest rewards.
Fixed an issue that prevented ‘Hive Divided’ and ‘A Dangerous Device’ daily quests in the Chronicle: Planebreaker Bastion: Aftermath from being offered.
Fixed an issue that prevented the Nightmare Coast Expert quest, ‘The stuff dreams are made of,’ from being completed.
Fixed a bug that caused the Faceless Man to offer the wrong quest set in Nightmare Coast (Expert). Quests in Nightmare Coast (Standard) no longer require returning to the Faceless Man for completion.
Fixed a bug that prevented victories in the Tenebrean Prison from counting toward for the quest, ‘To the Victor.’

tags.feature: Added The Tenebrean Prison to the list of Warfronts where the Daily PvP quest The Starfallen can be completed.

tags.bug: Victories in the Tenebrean Prison now count toward completion of the quest ‘By the Sword’.
Fixed bugs with daily quest completion counts and made the count increment only when reward is claimed.

tags.balance_change: Increased drop rate of Storm Cells.
Greatly increased the Legion Datagram rate.
Removed mana drain abilities from the raid.
Adjusted leash point for Greenscale encounter.
Adjusted leash point for Prince Hylas encounter.
Adjusted leash point for Oracle Aleria encounter.
Adjusted leash point for Duke letareus encounter.

tags.feature: Added encounter wall and leash radius to Uruluuk encounter.
Added encounter wall to Thalguur encounter.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted leash point for Anrak the Foul.
Adjusted leash point for Assault Commander Jorb.
Summerfest officially begins on Thursday, July 12, 2018 at 3:30 PM server time and runs until Thursday, August 2, 2018 at 3:30 PM server time.
The druids of Scarwood Reach have demanded a much bigger replanting effort this Summerfest, so there are three times the amount of trees available in the scavenger hunt.
Reduced the amount of Summerfest fungi that were placed tantalizingly out of reach, and uncollectable.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue that made disabling the tooltip anchor not actually disable ability tooltips.
Fixed an incorrect tooltip for Defensive Posture.
Fixed a bug where temporary or reactive abilities would disappear from your UI upon logging in or reloading your UI.
Fixed issue with previewing items causing other equipment to overlap with wardrobe previews.

tags.balance_change: Many weekly quests in Alittu now offer a choice between Tower Fragments, Ethereal Shards, and Legion Datagrams.
Reduced the Captured Intel costs on a number of items.
Essence Conversion will no longer consume damage modifying buffs.

tags.bug: Corrected the name of the Detonate damage from Scatter Sticky Bomb. Previously it was showing in combat logs as Scatter Sticky Bomb Boof.

tags.balance_change: Updated the ability descriptions for Empowering Strike, Power Strike, Swift Strike, Ravaging Strike, Shock Pulse and Seasoned Strike to reflect the changes to Legendary Tactics.
Updated Legendary Tactics. It can now proc, at most, every 3s. Increased damage per proc. Previously there was no internal cooldown on the damage proc.
Increased damage buff from Empower to 10%. Up from 5%.
Updated how bonus damage is calculated for Piercing Thrust and Wave of Steel when these abilities are used after a Warlord finisher.
For level 70 raid gear with randomized suffixes (concats), the odds of any particular concat have been evened out.

notes.title: Summerfest 2018
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/63dfc4cd1365cc0e52a56eb66aa9bfcc18ae498a.jpg[/img]

It’s as hot as a fire Rift outside, which can mean only one thing - it’s time for Summerfest in Telara! Running 07/12 – 08/02 and sporting a fantastic new tropical Tiki theme, Summerfest will get you through the heat in Island style! Grab a wild mask and jump on a surfboard for the best in summer fun!

RIFT’s annual summer holiday event, Summerfest is back! This year it runs from Thursday, July 12, 2018 at 3:30 PM PDT until Thursday, August 2, 2018 at 3:30 PM PDT. Even better, it will be available on both RIFT and RIFT Prime. Turn on the fan, spray some tropical scented oil around and escape the heat with us!

[h1]Summerfest Activities[/h1]
Summerfest offers several activities for all walks of Ascended:
[list]
 	[*]Scavenger Hunts[/*]
 	[*]Swarmlord Khargroth Battles[/*]
 	[*]Seasonal Quests[/*]
 	[*]Artifact Piñatas[/*]
 	[*]Mitch the Artifact Attractor Minion Questline (if you’ve already done this in previous years, it will not be available)[/*]
[/list]
[h1]New for Summerfest 2018![/h1]

[h1]Earn the Following Cool Items with Event Tokens:[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]The coveted Cosmic Seals with stats:
[list]
 	[*]Hallowed[/*]
 	[*]Mysterious[/*]
 	[*]Coveted[/*]
 	[*]Tough[/*]
 	[*]and Stalwart![/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[h1]New Summerfest Mount[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Island Surfboard[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Brand New Summerfest Dimension & Dimension Items[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Key to Dimension, Island Cove – the ultimate breezy, warm seaside beach, awaiting your footprints![/*]
 	[*]Summerfest Kit: Island Hut - for snuggling in at night (and to store your surfboard)[/*]
 	[*]Summerfest Kit: Tiki Bar – a definite must-have![/*]
[/list]
[h1]New Summerfest Companion Pets[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Brooster[/*]
 	[*]Red Parrot[/*]
 	[*]Blue Parrot[/*]
[/list]
[h1]Great New Cosmetic Wardrobe Items[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Playful Ears: Choose from Bunny, Fox, Cat or Deer[/*]
 	[*]Kelari Spiritcaller Headdress[/*]
 	[*]Farclan Warchief Headdress[/*]
 	[*]Mischievous Island Headdress[/*]
 	[*]Fierce Island Mask[/*]
 	[*]Intimidating Island Mask[/*]
 	[*]Mystical Island Mask[/*]
 	[*]Island Mask Backpack[/*]
 	[*]A bunch of boisterous Tiki-themed cosmetic weapons!
[list]
 	[*]Island Axe[/*]
 	[*]Island Cudgel[/*]
 	[*]Island Shanker[/*]
 	[*]Island Warglaive[/*]
 	[*]Island Staff[/*]
 	[*]Island Greatsword[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]PURCHASE THE FOLLOWING HOT NEW ITEMS WITH CREDITS![/b]

[b]New Wardrobe Items![/b]
[list]
 	[*]Island Dancer Regalia[/*]
 	[*]Swarmlord’s Insectoid Wings (bugs get bigger in the tropics, right?)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Dimensioneers gain a wide range of new Summerfest items![/b]
[list]
 	[*]Two Tiki Bars, Three Tiki Torches, Four Tiki Totems – Tiki Tiki TIKI!!!![/*]
 	[*]Summer Globe Lights in Blue, Green, Orange, Purple and Red, perfect for your beach party![/*]
 	[*]Beach Umbrellas in several colors[/*]
 	[*]Beach Chairs for when you get tired of dancing[/*]
 	[*]Five hammocks to choose from for the ultimate in comfort![/*]
 	[*]Fishing Net fence[/*]
 	[*]Seashells, because of course you need seashells for your beach![/*]
 	[*]Starfish – wait, is one of those twitching?[/*]
 	[*]Three Taro plants – decorative use only, do not attempt to eat (or let us know how it goes if you do)[/*]
 	[*]Short Wood Surfboard[/*]
 	[*]Rough Wooden Surfboard[/*]
 	[*]Polished Wooden Surfboard[/*]
 	[*]White Defiant Surfboard[/*]
 	[*]White Guardian Surfboard[/*]
[/list]
[b]SPECIAL NOTES FOR LIVE/PRIME:[/b]

Live players will be able to access the event section of the RIFT store

RIFT Prime will only have access to content in the original zones. Prime subscribers will be able to purchase most of the Summerfest items from vendors in Sanctum and Meridian.  The Nightmare Squirrel mount may drop from the final bosses of Expert Dungeons on Prime during this event!

[h1]What is Summerfest?[/h1]
You may be wondering about the origins of Summerfest.

While some of the history is lost to time, many scholars believe that Summerfest dates back to ancient elven rituals involving burning sacrifices inside wicker figures. Of course, most elves would prefer to forget these barbaric references to their past. In fact, such practices are now forbidden by both High Elves and Kelari alike, although sometimes alluded to by disgruntled Dwarves. What remains in modern Telara is a celebration of flames for all Ascended to enjoy.

Summerfest is now the holiday that marks the longest days of summer in Telara. Ascended continue to celebrate ancient traditions and have fun, even in the sweltering heat. This helps lighten the distract celebrants from the stress of the near-constant threats against Telara.

So don’t be late! Just like summer itself, the festivities won’t last long. Play RIFT or RIFT Prime and don’t forget to check out the seasonal in-game store for even more Summerfest goodies!

notes.title: Get Ready to Ride
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/3b0ad814af04aaedb2643a0ad8a29922c7a12e8c.jpg[/img]

Check out RIFT’s newest mount and get ready to #ShowUsYourSnail.

[h1]Apocalyptic Snail Rush[/h1]
The Plane of Earth contains vast desert wastes left behind by species such as the Architects. Existence can be difficult there, even for hardy species such as ogres. Some turn to an ascetic life contemplating the path of the Cosmic Rhinoceros, while others who have not given up their desire for acquiring plunder become brutal raiders. These ogre raiders travel the wastes on their fearsome Apocalypse Snails, one of the few other creatures that can both survive in the wastes, and carry the tremendous bulk of the ogre raiders, and their prodigious plunder. A number of these mounts have traveled through the rifts and have become prized by collectors who admire the wasteland chic desire, and how the snails will eat anything, often to the detriment of their keepers.

This all-new, totally badass Burning Apocalypse Snail mount is on the Live store now for 3,000 credits. It boats a 160% speed but will match the fastest mount in your stable. Once purchased, it will be available on all characters across your account (Live only). Ride to glory, Ascended!

[h1]#ShowUsYourSnail Challenge[/h1]
In honor of our new spiky friend, we welcome you to show off where you would take your new snail out in the real-world in our newest community challenge! Take the [url=http://www.trionworlds.com/rift/wp-content/uploads/sites/4/2018/06/Show-Us-Your-Snail-RIFT.png][u]photo we have here of the snail[/u][/url] and paste it into your IRL photo for a chance to win a new Apocalyptic Snail of your very own (only available on Live)! Get your pics in by 12:00 PM PDT on Monday, June 18, 2018. For complete details, check out the [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/general-discussions/news-announcements/505287-get-ready-ride.html][u]official Forum Post here[/u][/url].

[h1]RIFT Prime Summer Store Updates[/h1]
Live isn’t the only Telaran home getting cool, new stuff! RIFT Prime has all-new store items in time for our Summer Store update. New goodies include:
[list]

notes.title: Summer 2018 RIFT Updates - Official Dev Letter
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/547c20183d090381ab7b58ab4e4411317c77ddfa.jpg[/img]

Hail, Ascended!

A busy six weeks have passed since our spring update letter, and while it's not quite officially summer, the Rift team is full steam ahead preparing for long days and too-hot weekends where you can escape the heat outside by playing Rift! (If you're in the southern hemisphere, clearly you should also bundle up in a blanket with some Rift in the chilly evenings, just saying.)

Grab your sunglasses and a cold drink and let's get to it - and don't forget your towel!

[h1][u]Latest Balance Updates[/u][/h1]

The recent work on soul balance picked up speed with a significant set of ability updates in 4.4 Hotfix #13, published live on May 16th. This first pass brought a lot of focus on Warrior souls, with the goal of bringing them up to a more competitive state and more fun to play. If you were considering a new alt, now would be a good time to try a Warrior! Additional fixes went in for Clerics, Rogues, and Mages, as well as overall buff stacking groups between callings.

These balance changes are definitely not considered the end of ongoing soul work, but so far appear to bring us to a more even baseline for soul performance from which more targeted changes can be made. High on that list are Legendary Abilities, additional Warrior improvements, and a look at Clerics for both healing and DPS.

We'd like to offer great appreciation to those players who joined us on PTS Omega to review, parse, and give feedback on the combined changes prior to them going live! You can expect some more future patches to roll out in a similar manner, where a set of changes gets compiled over time, sent to PTS, then reviewed before integrating into the Live and Prime update schedule.

Speaking of PTS and content testing, we're about to have the ability to run both PTS Alpha and PTS Omega at the same time with the same patch, with the shards running different (Live and Prime) rulesets. When we get ready to enable them, we'll be taking PTS offline for a couple of days for behind-the-scenes work. It'll be worth it to be able to get both types of testing at the same time!

[h1][u]Latest Content Updates[/u][/h1]

The Seeker scavenger hunt event started on May 16th, and to be completely honest, there's some pleasant surprise at the collaboration we've seen! You've been teaming up to share coordinates and discussing the hunt on the forums - Rift players are the best. :) Good luck to those still working on the collection, and to those awaiting the challenge results!

Over on Prime, Greenscale made his grand appearance and many of the Ascended rose to the challenge - some of them even met with victory. If you're not quite raid-ready yet, don't fret! Additional changes went in to adjust overpowered Sliver boss abilities, and to smooth out the Prime experience curve. The update also reduced the platinum costs of expanded Role slots for those of you who prefer to have a spec ready for every situation.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/95d0c6117764869534f01055d3d8421fc4fa46d2.png[/img]

[h1][u]The Near Horizon[/u][/h1]

While the recent hotfixes have a strong balance focus, on the mid-term horizon we have folks already working on some really great summer events and laying the groundwork for some of our longer term content goals for Live as the Prophecy of Ahnket storyline continues. More frequent bonus events, like this last weekend’s bonus experience on both Live and Prime, are also in the cards. It's hard to talk details on some of these until the patches get closer to complete, but there are definitely some beans to spill. Not too many, though - don't want to spoil the picnic!

Summerfest approaches with the promise of relaxation in Telara - who says an Ascended can't take a vacation from saving the world? New art and dimension items are rolling in, and this writer might be biased, but our artists are killing it! There's also some cleanup work being done to improve the event experience this year.

Summerfest isn't the only world event on the horizon. We've mentioned previously that the team is working on the prelude event for River of Souls on Prime.  While these events may not be in the timeline for Live, they’re going to be fun and challenging content that we’ll be looking to release on all worlds! In that process we've uncovered other events from Rift's past that were not tied to specific holidays or raids, and the team is working on bringing these back for an encore on both the Live servers and Prime.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/7177dd96f684c21e98341fabe6838fe6fcdf41bc.png[/img]

[h1][u]Live[/u][/h1]

We have more than balance updates and events planned for Live servers this summer. The team is committed to improving the overall experience on Live servers, and some of the short- and mid-term focuses are:
[list]
 	[*]Bring more exciting rewards to the Daily Reward Calendar on Live, more in line with the Prime rewards.[/*]
 	[*]Add rare mount drops to Expert Dungeons and Raids on Live.  These extra rewards for play have been great on Prime, and this one is an idea that’s definitely worth taking to all servers.[/*]
 	[*]Revamp and reduce the credit store on Live. We're looking keenly at player feedback, especially some recent well-presented player discussions, to improve this area. While we view the store as a place for cosmetics, convenience, and some amount of ability for newer players to catch up with their friends, we don’t want it to be perceived as gameplay replacement, so we’ll be making upcoming changes with that in mind.[/*]
 	[*]Some may have noticed the recent trend on the Rift store to offer the latest mounts without releasing them inside of a lockbox, and you should expect more of that.[/*]
 	[*]As an advanced Soul Balance topic, revisiting the Eternal Weapons and their impact on builds.[/*]
 	[*]Planar Fragments, addressing their level of RNG and costs to upgrade.[/*]
 	[*]Warfront queue level banding is going to be getting a look in an upcoming test.  The more level bands and warfronts there are, the longer queueing takes.  Our goal here is to speed up the queues while keeping gameplay fun.[/*]
[/list]
We've got a jam-packed summer ahead of us, Ascended. We hope to see you well and victorious in Telara over the next few months!

- The Rift Team

Want to chat with us about this dev letter? Post your comments below!

tags.balance_change: Additional fixes went in for Clerics, Rogues, and Mages, as well as overall buff stacking groups between callings.
The update also reduced the platinum costs of expanded Role slots for those of you who prefer to have a spec ready for every situation.

Warfront queue level banding is going to be getting a look in an upcoming test. The more level bands and warfronts there are, the longer queueing takes. Our goal here is to speed up the queues while keeping gameplay fun.

notes.title: Make Telaran Memories This Weekend!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/d950dc59fc876c4cf4b104e9f15f75e1928f52ef.jpg[/img]
It's a long weekend here in the US, and we invite all our fellow RIFTers around the globe to join us. Kick back, relax and set your timers for bonus xp and gorgeous mounts!

[h1][/h1]
[h1]Here's all the details...[/h1]

[h1][b]BONUS EXPERIENCE WEEKEND![/b][/h1]
Last week's epic soul patch came with epic downtime - thanks for hanging in there with us! To make it up to you, we're adding bonus experience gains to both Live and Prime, in effect from Thursday, May 24 through Tuesday, May 29th!

(Insider note – bonus XP will actually run until the patch on Wednesday, May 30th – that time has not been set yet!)

[b]Live:[/b] 50% bonus to Guild XP and Planar Attunement XP

[b]Prime:[/b] 50% Adventuring XP

 
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/a592b66dcdd67c9da077398f11937eff81554704.jpg[/img]
[h1][b] [/b][/h1]
[h1][b]Live only: NEW BLOOD RAPTOR POWER PACK $19.99 USD[/b][/h1]
 

Fresh for Spring, we've lovingly hatched out an Blood Raptor, raised him on only the best food from Archonix' larder, armored him up and trained him to carry at the top speed of 160% anywhere you want! Yes, anywhere - we even taught him to swim!

This Raptor is happy to carry every character on your account.
Raptors can be notoriously shy when young, so we've included an adorable little buddy to go with: all your characters can now snuggle up to their very own [b]Verde[/b] pet!

It's the growing season, and it's far too easy to fill your pockets with all the things you pick up along the way - you clearly need a 40-slot Boundless Satchel to help you out.

We top it all off with a 15-day Patron Pass!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2480908/296623726d09146035ca67b6ac3417f8dd561a41.jpg[/img]

  
[h1][b]Live only: LIMITED TIME RARE MOUNT SALE[/b][/h1]
 

This weekend, you can take advantage of 25% off all current premium mount sales!

We also bring you a gorgeous carousel of rarely seen former supply crate mounts, rotating throughout the weekend. You'll have two chances to purchase each mount, so set your timers for the ones you love most!

All times below are in PDT.

May 24, 12:00 AM - 11:59 AM: Levitation
May 24, 12:00 PM - 11:59 PM: Golden Arclight Rider

May 25, 12:00 AM - 11:59 AM: Shadow Hellbug
May 25, 12:00 PM - 11:59 PM: Arclight Lifter

May 26, 12:00 AM - 11:59 AM: Nightmare Thresher
May 26, 12:00 PM - 11:59 PM: Black Empyreal Walker

notes.content:

My how time flies! Ascended, your third Prime challenge can be seen on the horizon! This time, we are focusing on a new challenge coming to both Prime and Live, as well as showcasing Twisted Artifacts and Crafting Rifts to Prime.


The [url=https://www.trionworlds.com/rift/en/2018/04/06/prime-vigil-second-challenge/][b]Second PRIME: VIGIL Challenge[/b][/url] ends on May 17th, so you still have time to hit your goals in that! We'll announce the winners the following week.


[h1][b]Now On to Challenge III![/b][/h1]

[B][i][EDIT: This event will now start on Wednesday, May 16th, after the patch! if the time or date of the patch changes, the event will change accordingly.][/i][/B]

The third challenge starts on May [s]18[/s] [b]16th[/b], 2018 at 12:01 AM PDT (7:00 AM UTC),

and ends on June 15, 2018 at 11:59 PM PDT (7:00 PM UTC 05/18/18)

 

[b]THE SEEKER[/b]

DeadSimon has lost a large number of Confounded Contraptions across old Mathosia. Collect all 110 to earn his everlasting gratitude!

The top three finishers and three who completed it any time during the event will receive the unreleased Demonette Wings, many months in advance of general release. In fact, the winners will get both the mount [u]and[/u] costume versions of the wings!

Everyone who finishes this achievement, forevermore, gains the title: "The Confounded." It's a new achievement (for Live and Prime) and will continue past the challenge phase.

First three to complete and three randomly drawn from all who complete during the event: A unique title that we want to open up to your ideas. [url=http://forums.riftgame.com/rift-prime-vigil-discussion-reading-anyone-posting-patron-only/prime-vigil-news-announcements/504695-prime-vigil-challenge-iii.html][u]Send us your suggestions![/u][/url]

More mayhem ensues as the coveted Twisted Artifacts become an even more valuable target on Prime. This is your advance notice to gather enough planarite to purchase Omen Sight or Quantum Sight in advance! Starting at the event kickoff on May 18th, collect 500 Twisted Artifacts! Sorry, the ones already in your pockets do not count.
